How I’m doing things differently from my colleagues across the aisle

Gabe Vasquez won the most competitive Democratic seat in Congress in 2022. He's running to be a champion for working families and build an economy that benefits everyone. Gabe here. In the last 90 days, House Republicans have done everything but accept accountability for the harm their party is doing in Congress and the White House. They refuse to answer to their constituents about why prices are still skyrocketing, why Elon Musk has free rein over government agencies, or why Donald Trump is dismantling our public education system piece by piece. **But I’m doing things differently from my colleagues across the aisle.** Last week, I held a town hall where my constituents were welcome to ask any and all questions about the work I’m doing in Congress. While I can’t answer for every travesty the Trump administration has committed since he took office, I need the people of NM-02 to know that I won’t sit back and watch as Republicans leave them behind in favor of unelected billionaires. I came to Congress to fight for New Mexico — period. The people I serve are my top priority, and I’ll never put political games ahead of their needs. That’s the kind of leadership Democrats need in Congress right now — **_and that’s the kind of action we need to take to flip the House blue next year._** [Now more than ever, I need grassroots supporters like you on my team. Peter,
---
None of this is easy for me to say, but here it goes...
---
All my life I’ve been known as a fighter.
---
I fought the mob head on in New York as America's mayor. I fought the sham witch hunts against President Trump. I’ve fought to defend my good name against the Left’s vicious lies, smears, and attacks.
---
**But over the past few years – and I hope you’ll agree – _I’ve fought the hardest of my ENTIRE life for my freedom and true justice._ **
---
The Radical Democrats and their accomplices labeled me a “ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_ ,” _RAIDED_ my home, _ARRESTED_ me, took a _MUGSHOT_ of me, and forced me into _BANKRUPTCY_.
---
[](http://links.americabrigade.com/s/c/-BevcRzKd0Q8FyiFgAt0DD4Ue8pQAuIwy3SZKWOfcXbWqCluEz6r-MrF8Z5IygI_LZF74Ma2zvc6SmRxv2B870Vw_dK1jZjATeccwtP6cWMu8r7UcFqZDirPIBzlNd3CidrVYJQrZocDO40oNF5scYioQkW69v8SMdIXGvF_fF4ISJgURav1iHgyDVXU6KK4CgTaZbCKUdFmNUy1Qbi-dN-Mz-osfvbN0Woz6flgDDl2tiAu3sj9CtSW_6ZByh4c_1RvEyeYatGpOrNY5cTgMwWDpXPDOXXWLmifRwr4ORdjoXUjuEd4uH1aUMeMexolGAY9W8esRT8fUFdbbyDknBeDXnEpwrci__WItc-_ZF1RzlJl7gaNrIYLz4rRVmzm0nGeTIYi7EUKAyMHLVzMwPSHXV5Jce_IG97dRCvGpDJh9N68zDBcxb5PI1DSV3mX9KHRB7rstBDvx0IkOwwlQdIbLN2X1ACQtMrkrWwx8Vli2gLFPkFBYkWGYB3x3w/0PGs4C1Y_TgLQBun5FJcHPbecv68rWJI/8)
__
---
_But every step of the way I’ve fought with every fiber of my being – supported by generous patriots like _YOU_ – and here I am, still standing!_
---
**However, the truth is, through every sham indictment, false arrest, and bogus charge where I’ve had to defend my innocence and good name, I’ve been saddled with enormous legal bills, unimaginable costs, and debts.**
---
**And if we’re being honest with each other, it’s a cost I simply cannot bear on my own.**
---
Make no mistake, this was the vindictive Democrats’ plan all along...
---
_This latest sham criminal case in Arizona – where if the Democrat Attorney General gets her way, I could take my last breath in prison – is designed to bleed me dry._
---
That’s why I now have no choice but to set a goal to raise $50,000 before week’s end for my Legal Defense Trust – the Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund – so that I can continue fighting to remain a FREE man.
---
I hate reaching out like this, and this is difficult for me to say, but right now, my fate is truly in _your_ hands.
---
_But let me make something perfectly clear: If you’re struggling right now or can’t afford to contribute, please know I understand. I would never want you to suffer hardship in your wish to alleviate my hardship. Take care of your family and yourself first! Your kind thoughts and prayers are more than enough. God Bless you!_

### **Fighting Billionaires Is Not Fun**
---
**I’m actively supporting citizen petition efforts in Alaska, Oregon, California, and several other states that will be launching soon.

Unfortunately, the citizen initiative process has been hijacked by billionaire-funded networks tied to George Soros, the Clintons, and foreign nationals like Hansjörg Wyss. These groups exploit nonprofit NGOs to funnel over $1.6 billion annually into campaigns that fundamentally reshape states year after year.

One foreign national alone—Hansjörg Wyss—has donated over $500 million, with more than $200 million going directly to ballot initiatives. Yet, there are no laws stopping this kind of foreign influence over our elections.

That’s why I’m leading the effort to make Alaska the second state in the nation—after Ohio—to ban foreign-funded ballot initiatives. Ohio implemented strict financial penalties for groups that accept foreign money for state campaigns. The law was so effective that these organizations scrambled to move millions into campaign accounts before the law took effect.

Think about it: 26 states allow citizen initiatives. Only one—Ohio—has safeguards against foreign interference. Alaska will be #2.

It’s time to take back the citizen initiative process from billionaires and unaccountable NGOs—and return it to the people.**
---
#### **Senator Bill’s Unicorn that never was**
---
**Sen. Bill Wielechowski is obviously not an economist or business major.**[**Click here to see his response and our argument**](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6809d0448e0bd70fcac8ae7e&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fposts%2Factivity-7319440665338163200-CdXw%3Frcm%3DACoAAA1pXpgBap4iF5P3-mMLQa7fT-RAG_NByPo%26utm_medium%3Dmember_desktop%26utm_source%3Dshare&w=636d98a80d1d302f275cb244&c=b_6809cc22fb694770a2ddf55a&l=en-US&s=GgB8q2AhdV-RDGoo98RjALbW-uo%3D)**

I am though so I’ll help. I was a business banker at Wells Fargo and Key Bank. I have done $36 million in lending in Alaska across every industry including a million dollar factoring line of credit to BP affiliates.

The claim that Senate Bill 113 won’t impact Alaskans directly is politically convenient, but economically incomplete. Here’s how the tax burden will almost certainly be passed on to the consumer, despite the framing:

1\. Businesses Always Pass Costs Downstream

Corporations, especially large online retailers, operate on tight margins and aim to protect shareholder value. When a new corporate income tax or nexus rule increases their tax burden in Alaska, they don’t absorb the cost—they adjust:
•Prices go up slightly on goods sold to Alaska.
•Or fees and shipping increase.
•Or discounts/promotions get trimmed back.

This is classic cost pass-through, a well-documented phenomenon in economics. Corporations bake these new costs into the price of goods and services, especially in remote markets like Alaska where options are limited and consumers are already used to paying more.

2\. The “Unicorn” Myth: No One Pays?

Sen. Wielechowski calls this a “unicorn” because it supposedly raises revenue without taxing Alaskans or Alaska-based businesses. But that relies on the assumption that out-of-state companies will eat the cost. They won’t.
•If Amazon, Best Buy, or Walmart must pay more tax on sales to Alaskans, the additional cost is treated like any other operating expense. Their pricing algorithms will reflect that.
•Alaskans will pay more for the same goods—just incrementally, and spread across many products.

It’s a hidden tax, not a tax-free windfall.

3\. Alaska’s Supply Chain Reality

Alaska’s economy is particularly vulnerable to price changes because:
•It relies heavily on imported goods, including nearly all online orders.
•Consumers have fewer alternatives to big national companies.
•Shipping costs are already high, and this new tax adds another layer of expense.

So while the law might “target” out-of-state corporations, the end-user—the Alaskan consumer—is where the economic pressure lands.

4\. Precedent From Other States

Proponents argue that 36 other states already have similar rules. That’s true—but in those states too, economists note that consumers ultimately foot the bill through:
•Slightly higher prices
•Slower shipping speeds
•Or reduced service in less-profitable regions (like rural Alaska)

Conclusion: Who Really Pays?

SB 113 = hidden tax on Alaskans.

Even if the tax technically targets corporations, businesses are not charities—as Sen. Mike Shower correctly pointed out. In the real world, the consumer always ends up holding the bag.

If Alaska needs revenue, this may be a pragmatic move—but calling it cost-free is misleading at best, and dishonest at worst.**

subject: Participate in our national CRT Survey
body:
There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Updates for Great Americans is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2z5ls9v45nup0u2lvp9ivvprhdogb1dclmq61mc2o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zsb22ncdtkj5s9aave0s5jp0frgj7ekg9i763hgo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](https://e.updatesforgreatamericans.com/rd/9z2zji6q66l23u109sbcapbbgogmquds3g13o0rkd0o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President

Hillsdale College

subject: Handing out Trump hats in the bluest areas in America

body:
I don’t send you many emails but I figured this was as good a time as any.

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zad1i33et9b0lbu1jmmc8ba7ssep74v7ll1k6nrg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o70s1h2bs)Hi - how are you?
This is Charlie Kirk. I don't send you many emails but I figured this was as good a time as any.
Why? Because my friend, Vivek Ramaswamy, just launched his campaign for Ohio Governor and I have a lot to say about it. Let me start off with this:
Vivek is the real deal. He's whip smart, quick on his feet, knows exactly why he believes what he believes, and he'll be a reliable partner to President Trump at the state level. He will make for an excellent Governor of a critically important state. [In a minute, I'm going to ask for you to make a donation to his campaign, but first, let me go on.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zmbdrbusp734bolgrr9kre30593tjm3rknckjt18_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o70s1h2bs)
I put my faith in Vivek 100%. I know who he really is because we were in the trenches together at the height of the election.
He and I barnstormed the country - focusing most of our attention on college campuses - campaigning for President Trump.
* We faced off with purple-haired, nonbinary socialists who called us every ugly slur in the books
* We handed out Trump hats to (previously) undecided voters
* We generated hundreds of millions of views across every social media platform to convert every Gen-Z voter we possibly could

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zj623umug619sulfprt4jiokbpln2jk277tpib9o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o70s1h2bs)When we look back and see that Gen-Z LURCHED toward President Trump, I like to think me and Vivek's hard work paid off.
So when he threw his hat in the ring, it wasn't a hard call to support him.
I've seen that guy go viral time and time again for methodically picking apart the cheap talking points folks heard from MSNBC or Democrat influencers.
He'll do the same when anyone gets in the way of him **SLASHING** the state income tax, **SECURING** our elections, **CUTTING** wasteful spending, **FIXING** Ohio schools, and **HELPING TRUMP** Make America Great Again! [That's why I encourage you in the strongest possible terms to support his campaign for Governor.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zpa0a7oj25ea52e806sp6m466jj62map1krodmh0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o70s1h2bs)__Whether you live in Ohio or not is beside the point.
When he wins, Vivek will move at lightning speed to fix the government - just like President Trump is doing on the national level right now. Then he'll set an example for the other 49 states.
I know in my heart of hearts that Vivek will make you proud.
He'll make me proud, too.

---
__
Thanks for hearing me out. God bless you.

Sincerely,
Charlie Kirk

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to children’sentertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2gqjpqoggqp7dv2r2hannu2ntjaocvpmuej1fr8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvei9d9j3j7udg47ghegn2r9j61pj1uv5djn94n8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z51trnlm36mfusg4pgib2trtslgiv8s58sdctceg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3s6r4jv70061fqebi8g2haanidtcj4u3gsefo5o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3p9r3sog2gobes5fuoff6o92avhchcs4jf7nafg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge1o71c9h2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z79r8rimtg5b92jeood20uvpi0jqelh33f2f70o0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge9pr1chh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z6lsqcvedis4tfhmj7055an0nv9aisscopil7fco_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge9pr1chh2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlg1nbpcq760nlh6kpvk1hu4rnb7kobd3oudir3g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge9pr1chh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zqulncvgojqp9pkqgjv3jja068fm4uggae5cbgu8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge9pr1chh2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zci2a0b5sgvpqs7iqvqt1cj13vklnb76ot98c5oo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ge9pr1chh2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.

Sincerely,

body:
God led me to share my story with the world – warts and all.

| |
---
| | | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zfdkba8o7msk8ho3bsi1qhvh11dchd64h7ktmtt0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "Vice President JD Vance")
---

My fellow Americans - it is Vice President JD Vance.

_**[This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z79jq8glma90v6msqqmuogtuh8vv8lbnf5pt9h9g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.")**_

It wasn't easy telling the world I grew up poor, raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.

It wasn't exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

I'll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I'll fight every day for good folks like you.

I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

_**[Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z61qabb13jtb6hh9tfv71g70rjqc36tr48rqk6sg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.")**_

We're coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win.

So now we're forced to rebuild.

The Democrat Machine is **ALREADY** crushing us in fundraising, **ALREADY** outspending us in key races, and **ALREADY** building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections.

At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable.

So here's my final pitch to you:

_**[I'm teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise - for the FIRST TIME since the election - to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zgtsd3a3dcdlgdq08s73jgivtn4hes078p9haq60_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise – for the FIRST TIME since the election – to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.")**_ I understand that's ambitious. But if that's what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it's a no-brainer I'll do what it takes to win.

Do you think you can help us get there?

_Whether it 's $5 or $500 - the amount you give isn't nearly as important as how many folks step up:_
---
| | | [PLEASE JOIN US](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zpqpis3ulo0eros3sri4efktlu22ile64ahhatko_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "PLEASE JOIN US")
---
Look, you've probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point.

If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it's to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That's why I'm partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win.

_**[I don't ever want you to donate more than you can afford - but if you can spare ANYTHING, even a few bucks, it would be tremendously appreciated.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zag2ufd35iskcri981q8rsb5lvr3kgve2n60fr9o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "I don’t ever want you to donate more than you can afford – but if you can spare ANYTHING, even a few bucks, it would be tremendously appreciated.")**_

Regardless, it's an honor to fight alongside you.

God bless America,
Vice President JD Vance
---
| | | [PLEASE JOIN US](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsgka4nql30grpgdcq47qgt5ph5t5ekfgc4eg728_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "PLEASE JOIN US")

_It 's Majority Leader Scalise._

We will make the first sprint of the new Congress the most efficient political operation this country has ever seen. And before doing anything else, I'm launching my _**[First 100 Days Survey](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zp85v6cg1khd4gt6l62pktod7rn537m9q0qqm6lo_rp22sh2s8i6eob5c5ie6p74chh2bs "First 100 Days Survey")**_ so you can weigh in on what we should prioritize first.

name: Vivek Ramaswamy
subject: What I do when protestors show up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VIVEK RAMASWAMY FOR OHIO
body:
Echo chambers don’t solve anything. Real conversations do.

[](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._WfmRBm4Aw)Peter -
When protestors show up at my events, I don't hide. I don't shut off their microphones. I walk right up to them and start the conversation.
Because this campaign isn't about echo chambers. It's about building something bigger - a movement rooted in truth, courage, and open debate.
**That 's how I've always operated.**
Back in 2024, I joined Charlie Kirk on campuses across the country to take on the tough questions, face protestors head-on, and speak truth without fear.[](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews._DyPuXzOJspZ6zQ)**Now I 'm doing the same thing here in Ohio. And I won't stop.**
Because we're not just trying to win an election.
We're trying to revive a broken culture - and that starts with showing up, speaking clearly, and refusing to back down.
But I can't do this alone.
If you believe in this movement - if you believe in leading with conviction and not censorship - I'm asking two things of you:
**FIRST:** [](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)[Chip in any amount you can comfortably spare to help us grow this campaign across Ohio.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
**SECOND:** Do something even more important: **Talk.**
Talk about this campaign. Talk about what President Trump is doing at the federal level. Talk about what we stand for - even with the folks who disagree with you.
Because that's how we build a movement that can't be ignored. **That 's how we win in 2026 (and beyond)!**
It won't always be easy. You might get pushback. You might get some raised eyebrows. But when people hear the truth - when they see you stand proudly for what you believe - they listen.
We don't win by staying quiet.
[We win by showing up.](https://trk.emails.dailygopnews.)
Together, we'll make history!
God bless you,

## RFK Jr. Sets Ban on 8 Food Dyes
Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. announced Tuesday plans to [ban eight government-approved synthetic food dyes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOpCAURb9GOwwiKhYU29jNtluaJzz0zSIYYMb49xu32B_Y7iYnubn3_HotLyBPYfsJB-ri4hLwyh5LwbS4GK29cYVgdoRCYQPaPOS8CC56xiUTcrFA_l5kbbVDFNjVqNtR9lJN7TjUu-77HhDd0ClY3TQpZUBahePUK6dWsdaknzYuhWw5H1rZdApAohiNmHBcB15JjpZKTM07Uig7On_HL6bGxKP2ei_lzFX3oxJzJebrupqwmufFwysx7wi-7P8Ce1Al5uR-s3diEEL8BIOZnR5CZgmP-EUGqZAjQ-CZvTGzAIViyOxRwvLnPP3NkgkguGiVrJO250XeUx7GSvLtAPJ_55X_cvrV4k8AAAD__yc3jgQ) from the U.S. food supply within two years. Several of these artificial dyes already face restrictions in the European Union, Australia, and Canada. [Here’s a list of the dyes](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ_GdLOyB_NXuEhDt2lTogEP4I3ByPbuirePnFf4upFG9-je8-c5Pcl5d26_6WCT1zCd_E2ec-Y4rSFYe_NM57IzZXdu5DZPKU0osQGpAfVkyfl70pU1KzNyXbFRnW50P6iurXYzaMZBycbKdlkaS7UcFM5Lr7qGW2ZVOVNoUqNWUrZKP-qeSDN2Cw7cza0UWrJ1OcTHK7gz77z6O3w4PpZwVN7sOV9J1L8EjgLH875CyuUlcCxggaPU5UaB4ztB2SdwjOtfeEVYLcHXeQ_XTokhvDP0cHGOwfP7gJkSW7A3J3AnFB8Cxyoae5WQS20ntNwOcv5_mfwjgx-D_wIAAP__O_iDMA). Kennedy also declared sugar "poison" on Tuesday and recommended Americans consume "zero" added sugar, while acknowledging the federal government likely cannot eliminate it from food products. Kennedy emphasized the need for better food labeling and new nutrition guidelines recommending people avoid sugar completely. [Watch his speech here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd1jwwBAXFNtY22TbLa1n87DJEBMBk8h_P0p-Ydp7pXt1zv_rfMWY4rH9wzu5FvJ80Ksmao3KHHL2_qQFj3UnbPHYMG4Ja51BwMCF5qBnjzGds-68C0RAqiMnrR70ZZTWdLtTRpmgjAC1CD0O1pLw0hs9hBHVYE0X3XtNaNBSCCN1ry6ImsCuMJJdjGBakI8tl_6W49F2CunMTyr9mu9dcntrj8rUHwYTgwmX9U3Qb_ldM5j-Eqa2M5ie0VNmMO2fgFdaCzUsJy_hi98Kr98bFv7IseaDS5BSgDGmK84_XjGlWI1lWmx3jOnz3H6l6-ngJwAA__8ZnX1B).
## Dick Durbin, Senate’s No. 2 Democrat, to Retire
Sen. Dick Durbin of Illinois, the Senate’s No. 2 Democrat, announced Wednesday he [will not seek a sixth term in 2026](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNkfm8bDJ4KFLtnTtiIz9DC81dmTcRPx9RX-h49WVru45X_fpbjlyWj7tRqaGPCV675FqpTKFnL0_aLbJrWQrp8XyEu2-TyBhEBIF4OQtx2PC1ptABNS3ZDqNA47XTqt2NWOQKvToB1Dae30Ng3c6EGDww6yHvmVzrkkE7KRUHV760Vok0A6upGclG5TkueZyeWROdaUQj_yicnF5a6NZa33uTf_RwK2Bm32eAGd1hlLZRWrg5tl9C_9TZk5ip2QriUIUyVXOSWz2kQvXQ0gIATypHp0kNSsYEcIoiYLsggZqi_HPN8fIu9INymWzHP9-1H_Jexn4DQAA__9gdIMD), ending a congressional career that began in 1982. The 80-year-old has been a central figure in Democratic leadership, and his departure is expected to spark a [crowded and competitive Democratic primary](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOnDAURb_GdB4Z2zPMFi5YrZBSbJoUKdHDfsBLjI3st4P4-4j8wnZXutLVPef35_gJFCktP2FDx3MeEx41IjOWcc45hBMnSH5FYEoL0BKh1lErfZfKSm3HABTP0TbBzYgaTYOu7ezdPt_a7tGszt4NAlgIxrTKWP-cQJn5id5MALO9N-SuNWW1bZV6tPZmngAWdef1G3bTQwmrMBDncvuTKfGKczzzC8vN562JbmXeqzC90IPQw3Ect62mqxN6wCS_qtDDBSX0sOdITP6KlCoFlAG37AtwlXtmTEwQ4yknuvjlXmiDcsqZlpUlZ1lwj-BRBvJ_ZfgqEyWhByiy79sP7t9_CDNkT0GYj_fLKR71F5a9KS7sB8VI9dEJq5YNKP5_z99S_nL6XwAAAP__gaGYRg) in Illinois.

Reps. Lauren Underwood and Raja Krishnamoorthi are viewed as early frontrunners, with Krishnamoorthi holding a major fundraising edge thanks to a $19 million war chest. Durbin predicted “at least a dozen” candidates could enter the race.

# [Michelin began reviewing restaurants to boost tire sales.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| A Michelin star is one of the highest honors in the culinary world, signifying exceptional quality in a restaurant’s cuisine. The coveted rating is considered the authority on fine dining around the world, but the Michelin Guide started as little more than a driver’s roadside companion. In the late 19th century, brothers André and Édouard Michelin founded the Michelin tire manufacturing company in Clermont-Ferrand, France. At the time, the automobile industry was still on the rise, with only around 3,000 cars on the road. In 1900, as a way to promote more automobile travel and, in turn, [boost tire sales for their company](https://track.historyfacts.com/?xtl=1n3yr048yvc7rutznmmjzzazrlferhtpk3jq0tc77p4vyu21hx417wy5l7uwutxaxdqfv0g4uvxzzdvaf92lfpy6wf9tbkyim9dctxa7u3dltfdjtadhn70ua84pbyml28p5uv6cgzhguy95ybrgotohpw2ejpn9xog60rez214zd33i7tydv7q71x4xjqe0pgi6vwfs6l9aiwc10gshch8eoz5tos66cblzkkf19s5gw4xqmo3dv9ls6lydjbj22gthsug9ub7bvpqzstjgkvjj&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), the Michelin brothers launched the Michelin Guide. The free book included relevant information for motorists such as maps, tire repair tips, and listings of fuel retailers, accommodations, and places to eat.
---
As the guide evolved, so did its approach to evaluating dining establishments. Readers showed interest in the restaurant and hotel information, and in the 1920s, Michelin began hiring critics to anonymously assess and review restaurants at length. The famed “star” system debuted in 1926; at first, rankings consisted only of a single star, but by 1931, the three-star system still used today made its debut. A single star [denoted](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) "a very good restaurant," two stars signified "excellent cooking worth a detour," and three stars represented "exceptional cuisine worth a special journey." To date, Michelin has sold more than 30 million copies of its guidebooks, and chefs who have been on the receiving end of a star have said that the prestige does indeed increase business. Michelin, however, doesn’t disclose whether the guides are profitable to the company, nor just how many tires the guides have helped it sell.

## Karl Benz’s wife, Bertha Benz, took the world’s first road trip.
Karl Benz (of Mercedes-Benz fame) is well known for being an automobile pioneer. As his business partner, his wife Bertha Benz also deserves accolades, as well as a more adventurous automotive claim to fame. In August 1888, Bertha and her teenage sons [secretly embarked](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sv7wlp&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) on the first long-distance automobile journey when they took Karl's motorized vehicle, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, without his knowledge. Bertha left a note for Karl, and took the kids to visit her mother, traveling about 60 miles from Mannheim to Pforzheim, Germany. Along the way, she improvised necessary repairs — including using a hat pin to unclog a carburetor — and stopped at a pharmacy in Wiesloch to fuel up with Ligroin, a cleaning agent that worked as fuel. The trip was a success, and proved the automobile was on its way to being road-ready for the masses. Bertha’s road trip route was commemorated as the Bertha Benz Memorial Route in 2008, and in 2016, she was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame.

clean_body: A Michelin star is one of the highest honors in the culinary world, signifying exceptional quality in a restaurant’s cuisine. | A Michelin star is one of the highest honors in the culinary world, signifying exceptional quality in a restaurant’s cuisine. The coveted rating is considered the authority on fine dining around the world, but the Michelin Guide started as little more than a driver’s roadside companion. In the late 19th century, brothers André and Édouard Michelin founded the Michelin tire manufacturing company in Clermont-Ferrand, France. At the time, the automobile industry was still on the rise, with only around 3,000 cars on the road. In 1900, as a way to promote more automobile travel and, in turn, , the Michelin brothers launched the Michelin Guide. The free book included relevant information for motorists such as maps, tire repair tips, and listings of fuel retailers, accommodations, and places to eat. As the guide evolved, so did its approach to evaluating dining establishments. Readers showed interest in the restaurant and hotel information, and in the 1920s, Michelin began hiring critics to anonymously assess and review restaurants at length. The famed “star” system debuted in 1926; at first, rankings consisted only of a single star, but by 1931, the three-star system still used today made its debut. A single star "a very good restaurant," two stars signified "excellent cooking worth a detour," and three stars represented "exceptional cuisine worth a special journey." To date, Michelin has sold more than 30 million copies of its guidebooks, and chefs who have been on the receiving end of a star have said that the prestige does indeed increase business. Michelin, however, doesn’t disclose whether the guides are profitable to the company, nor just how many tires the guides have helped it sell. | By clicking a link in this email, you're agreeing to our and . Karl Benz (of Mercedes-Benz fame) is well known for being an automobile pioneer. As his business partner, his wife Bertha Benz also deserves accolades, as well as a more adventurous automotive claim to fame. In August 1888, Bertha and her teenage sons on the first long-distance automobile journey when they took Karl's motorized vehicle, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen, without his knowledge. Bertha left a note for Karl, and took the kids to visit her mother, traveling about 60 miles from Mannheim to Pforzheim, Germany. Along the way, she improvised necessary repairs — including using a hat pin to unclog a carburetor — and stopped at a pharmacy in Wiesloch to fuel up with Ligroin, a cleaning agent that worked as fuel. The trip was a success, and proved the automobile was on its way to being road-ready for the masses. Bertha’s road trip route was commemorated as the Bertha Benz Memorial Route in 2008, and in 2016, she was inducted into the Automotive Hall of Fame. **Good Morning!** On this day in 1911, the [Magnolia Petroleum Company](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFygzAQAF8jOhghHbJVqEhD57QpmTM6QBMhMdLF2L_POF_IB3Zn9-s23TDEkNZP3Mnxc8lTorNGYqYyLYEqY8WEiXMKeccQeaOFJyXV0EpoFUweQ3xN0Hh3l972Dbn-AgNYBVfbbA7AoPF3rc1lMVaBRT3QtTdIg9YSbRPcGyZBQd_LXg3dvFhthiugNF7OdhYgyQfOpeONmJ5Yl_jKDyrdnPcmuo35qEJ_CDUKNZ7n2XHdMKcYEnW5rEKNGyZ_z_lbqJESl0BVqHHHNeUYsD2IS470s7dz3g9Mr6Y4f5whxlDNRYBc3-F_Nv7fo4dTvwEAAP__-H59Dw) was founded. subject: The Mountain Minute: 4/24/2025
body:
Colorado law limits what voters can verify—and critics say that needs to change
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
Listen to today's **Mountain Minute Podcast** [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** A sweeping [social media bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) (SB25-086) may soon land on Gov. Polis’ desk, requiring tech platforms to remove illegal content or face penalties. It’s backed by parents of overdose victims but could face a veto over privacy concerns. Meanwhile, [Uber is threatening to exit](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Colorado if HB25-1291 passes, citing mandates like mandatory ride recording and increased liability for drivers. And as election reform debate grows, critics say Colorado’s laws prevent voters from truly [verifying their own ballots](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—even as Mesa County offers unprecedented ballot image access.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Mesa County launched its [Ballot Verifier](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), giving voters access to ballot images without a CORA request—Idaho was the first state to [launch this tool](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Douglas County will [consolidate six schools](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) due to falling enrollment, and Denver officials are debating a [$70M women’s soccer stadium](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) projected to bring $2.2B in economic impact.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** A federal judge has extended a [block on deportations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) under the Alien Enemies Act, halting the Trump administration’s use of the 1798 law to remove Venezuelan migrants from Colorado. The Trump administration’s Education Department also issued a [warning to Colorado lawmakers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.): parents—not the state—have the final say on gender-related issues, amid backlash to HB25-1312.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** Shaina Cole blasts Denver’s [soft-on-crime approach](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), highlighting cases where gang-affiliated criminals were released on low bail despite ICE holds. Meanwhile, Craig Hall torches the Grand Junction City Council for greenlighting a park overhaul voters rejected—calling it [tone-deaf political theater](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, April 24, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Colorado law limits what voters can verify—and critics say that needs to change](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Mesa County’s Ballot Verifier tool has been praised for giving residents unprecedented access to redacted ballot images and cast vote records. But for some longtime election integrity advocates, it’s only part of the solution.
“This is a great step forward,” said Ed Arnos, a Mesa County resident and former lottery systems designer. “But it doesn’t verify the most important part—how the ballots were actually read.”
_This article is Part 3 of a three-part series on the Ballot Verifier:[Mesa’s launch](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), [Ada County’s pilot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and the debate over [election transparency laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)._

**[Cole: Denver’s dangerous dance with low cash bail and ICE detainer policies puts public safety at risk](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Violent offenders like Bayron Turcios-Murillo, a confirmed Tren de Aragua gang member arrested with nearly 1,000 fentanyl pills, have been released on low cash bonds—just $10,000 in his case—despite serious public safety risks.
* The city routinely gives ICE detainer notice windows of less than an hour, making it nearly impossible for federal agents to take custody of high-risk suspects before release, as seen in recent cases involving gang-linked individuals.
* Author Shaina Cole argues Denver’s bail and sanctuary policies prioritize ideology over safety, urging longer ICE notification times and higher—or denied—bonds for gang-affiliated suspects to prevent them from returning to the streets.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Uber warns it may leave Colorado if new rideshare bill becomes law](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* HB25-1291 would require rideshare companies to conduct biannual background checks, record every ride, and investigate complaints within 72 hours. Uber says the mandates are unworkable and could force it to shut down statewide.
* Uber argues the bill compromises user privacy, exposes drivers to lawsuits, and unfairly targets rideshare apps while exempting taxis and shuttles. The company is urging users to oppose the bill before the May 7 deadline.
* Bill sponsors say the legislation addresses serious safety concerns, citing rising sexual assault cases. Rep. Jenny Willford, a survivor herself, accused Uber of failing to protect riders despite repeated promises.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Polis faces pressure as veto showdown looms on sweeping social media bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CPR NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Senate Bill 86 would require large social media companies to cooperate with law enforcement on illegal content involving drugs, guns, and exploitation of minors. It passed with broad support after parents and DAs cited tragic cases like fentanyl overdoses tied to online sales.
* Gov. Polis opposes key provisions, warning the bill could infringe on free speech, violate the Colorado Privacy Act, and force tech platforms to act as law enforcement. His office described the bill as having “fundamental flaws.”
* If Polis vetoes the bill, sponsors say they have enough support for a rare override—pointing to the urgent need for platform accountability in protecting children from online threats.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[From critics to champions: How a ballot transparency tool won over Idaho voters—and inspired Mesa County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN****| NATIONAL | APRIL 23** _When Ada County launched a ballot audit tool built by a small independent company, no one knew what to expect. But what followed surprised even the clerk who helped shape it._
**[Mesa County launches Ballot Verifier, giving voters unprecedented access to ballots](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | LOCAL | APRIL 23** _Mesa County launched a first-of-its-kind ballot transparency tool last month, allowing residents to view redacted ballot images and corresponding cast vote records online—without filing a CORA request. Supporters say it could reshape public trust in elections. Others say it doesn’t go far enough._
__
**[Not political theater: Montrose federal intervention request grounded in Constitutional oath](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | NATIONAL | APRIL 22** _On April 16, the Montrose County Board of County Commissioners voted 2–1 to send a formal Request for Federal Intervention to President Donald Trump, Attorney General Pam Bondi, and the U.S. Supreme Court. Commissioner Sue Hansen abstained._

body:
This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it start to finish:

| |
---
| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "Vice President JD Vance")
---

My fellow Americans – it is Vice President JD Vance.

_**[This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "This is a longer email but I respectfully ask you to read it from start to finish.")**_

It wasn’t easy telling the world I grew up poor, raised by my Mamaw while my mother struggled with addiction.

It wasn’t exactly the prep school/trust fund/summer-in-the-Hamptons upbringing that is commonplace in DC.

**But I felt called to tell my story. Warts and all.** I felt led to speak out because I think millions of Americans share stories like mine. Stories of jobs being outsourced to China, addiction ravaging communities and killing our neighbors, and heeding the call of duty after the Towers fell on 9/11.

_As your Vice President, I now stand in the breach for the left-behind, forgotten men and women who built this country, but were abandoned by the political class in DC. _

I’ll do everything in my power to make sure that never happens again. I’ll fight every day for good folks like you.

I promise to always stand between you and the Democrat Machine that aims to obliterate everything that makes our country great.

_**[Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "Which brings me to the purpose of my email today.")**_

We’re coming out of the most expensive election in American history. I mean that. Kamala Harris spent over a billion dollars against us. It took EVERY PENNY we had to get our story out there, expose her ultra-Liberal record, reach undecided voters, and win.

So now we’re forced to rebuild.

The Democrat Machine is **ALREADY** crushing us in fundraising, **ALREADY** outspending us in key races, and **ALREADY** building the campaign infrastructure to decimate us in the Midterm Elections.

At this point, the consequences of simply resting on our laurels would be unthinkable.

So here’s my final pitch to you:

_**[I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise – for the FIRST TIME since the election – to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise – for the FIRST TIME since the election – to raise a million dollars by the end of the month.")**_ I understand that’s ambitious. But if that’s what it takes to deliver President Trump a Republican House for his entire second term, it’s a no-brainer I’ll do what it takes to win.

Do you think you can help us get there?

_Whether it’s $5 or $500 – the amount you give isn’t nearly as important as how many folks step up:_
---
| | | [PLEASE JOIN US](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "PLEASE JOIN US")
---
Look, you’ve probably heard bits and pieces of my story at this point.

If my humble beginnings taught me anything, it’s to never give up, never surrender, and never go down without a fight. That’s why I’m partnering with Steve Scalise to help lay the critical groundwork we need to win.

_**[I don’t ever want you to donate more than you can afford – but if you can spare ANYTHING, even a few bucks, it would be tremendously appreciated.](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "I don’t ever want you to donate more than you can afford – but if you can spare ANYTHING, even a few bucks, it would be tremendously appreciated.")**_

Regardless, it’s an honor to fight alongside you.

God bless America,
Vice President JD Vance
---
| | | [PLEASE JOIN US](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGc/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "PLEASE JOIN US")
---

---
| |
* * *
---
| [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGd/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "First 100 Day Survey")
---

_It’s Majority Leader Scalise._

We will make the first sprint of the new Congress the most efficient political operation this country has ever seen. And before doing anything else, I’m launching my _**[First 100 Days Survey](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/amGd/?__vbtrk=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjg2NDExOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct "First 100 Days Survey")**_ so you can weigh in on what we should prioritize first.

I don’t send you many emails but I figured this was as good a time as any.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziuq53angd4g9gcf2olgptf8uld1n0bk2s69u1vg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli68pj4c5h2bs)Hi - how are you?
This is Charlie Kirk. I don't send you many emails but I figured this was as good a time as any.
Why? Because my friend, Vivek Ramaswamy, just launched his campaign for Ohio Governor and I have a lot to say about it. Let me start off with this:
Vivek is the real deal. He's whip smart, quick on his feet, knows exactly why he believes what he believes, and he'll be a reliable partner to President Trump at the state level. He will make for an excellent Governor of a critically important state. [In a minute, I'm going to ask for you to make a donation to his campaign, but first, let me go on.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4auott8qo0kv3aubecd4acepnlr7vqu5nqir6l8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli68pj4c5h2bs)
I put my faith in Vivek 100%. I know who he really is because we were in the trenches together at the height of the election.
He and I barnstormed the country - focusing most of our attention on college campuses - campaigning for President Trump.
* We faced off with purple-haired, nonbinary socialists who called us every ugly slur in the books
* We handed out Trump hats to (previously) undecided voters
* We generated hundreds of millions of views across every social media platform to convert every Gen-Z voter we possibly could

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6mfl7akr5ed1d99n82ipqagttf4r23f0414ht3o_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli68pj4c5h2bs)When we look back and see that Gen-Z LURCHED toward President Trump, I like to think me and Vivek's hard work paid off.
So when he threw his hat in the ring, it wasn't a hard call to support him.
I've seen that guy go viral time and time again for methodically picking apart the cheap talking points folks heard from MSNBC or Democrat influencers.
He'll do the same when anyone gets in the way of him **SLASHING** the state income tax, **SECURING** our elections, **CUTTING** wasteful spending, **FIXING** Ohio schools, and **HELPING TRUMP** Make America Great Again! [That's why I encourage you in the strongest possible terms to support his campaign for Governor.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z3sodd49d6ukufh71h2ec85epd6f1snb42s9toog_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli68pj4c5h2bs)__Whether you live in Ohio or not is beside the point.
When he wins, Vivek will move at lightning speed to fix the government - just like President Trump is doing on the national level right now. Then he'll set an example for the other 49 states.
I know in my heart of hearts that Vivek will make you proud.
He'll make me proud, too.

Thanks for hearing me out. God bless you.

Sincerely,
Charlie Kirk

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: Switching into a higher gear / Cambiar a una marcha más alta
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Keeping up the fight to protect healthcare for millions
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Cornyn%20Houston%20office%20protest%20April%2025.jpg]
When our rights and programs are under attack, WE FIGHT BACK!
On Tuesday, TOP Harris County staff and members protested outside Sen. John Cornyn’s Houston district office with community members, calling him out for continuing to rubber-stamp Trump's authoritarian agenda that puts the lives of millions of his own constituents at risk.
Our state’s senior U.S. senator is failing Texas families at every turn, and with devastating cuts to Medicaid and SNAP looming, he's towing the Republican party line and serving as nothing more than a MAGA mouthpiece. Help us fight back against these cuts.
Fill out this form to call your member of Congress and send them an email demanding they oppose ALL cuts to Medicaid and SNAP. [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html]
To learn more about TOP's healthcare justice work and how you can join, contact Irie at ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] .
CONTACT YOUR STATE REP:
Keep up the pressure against anti-tenant bills HB32 and SB38
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eviction%20notice%20sticker.jpg]
HB32 [https://www.expressnews.com/opinion/editorial/article/texas-house-bill-32-squatter-eviction-20227578.php] and its Senate companion SB38 [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/fight-against-squatters-could-bring-faster-evictions-for-all-texas-renters/] are anti-renter bills that chip away at tenant protections, making evictions even harder to fight. These bills allow landlords to evict tenants without prior notice or legal proceedings for reasons other than non-payment of rent, enabling judgments without a hearing in some instances.
While authors of these bills claim they will address the issue of squatting, they instead infringe on tenants' due process rights, and will hurt Texans already struggling to make ends meet. These pieces of legislation aren’t about squatters — they’re tools to fast-track evictions and silence working-class Texans fighting unfair displacement.
Together, we can run the clock out on these bad bills, but we need your help.
CALL your state representative and senator to urge them to oppose HB32 and SB38! [https://www.texastribune.org/directory/]
Congratulating allies on exciting news
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PPTV%20Shellie%20graphic.jpg]
Join us in cheering on Shellie Hayes-McMahon as she steps into her new role as Executive Director of Planned Parenthood Texas Votes! This is a milestone for both our state and our movement, as this is the first time the organization has been solely led by a Black woman.
Texas is ground zero for abortion bans — and now, with Shellie leading PPTV, we have a powerful voice even more present in the fight.
Shellie's leadership, experience, and bold vision come at a critical moment for the fight for reproductive freedom in Texas and beyond. Congratulations from Team TOP, Shellie!
TOP Tip: Head to the polls, Texas!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20vote.jpg]
Local elections are underway across the state! Early voting started, Tuesday, April 22, and goes through Tuesday, April 29. Election Day is Saturday, May 3. EVERY election matters and impacts our communities. CLICK HERE for more information about these elections and what will be on your ballot. [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/04/01/texas-local-voter-guide-2025-san-antonio-denton-el-paso-dallas/]
Español
Manteniendo la lucha para proteger la atención médica para millones de personas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Cornyn%20Houston%20office%20protest%20April%2025.jpg]
Cuando nuestros derechos y programas son atacados, ¡NOSOTROS CONTRAATACAMOS!
El martes, el personal y los miembros de TOP del Condado de Harris protestaron frente a la oficina del senador John Cornyn en el distrito de Houston junto con miembros de la comunidad, criticándolo por seguir aprobando la agenda autoritaria de Trump, que pone en riesgo la vida de millones de sus electores.
El senador estadounidense de mayor rango de nuestro estado está fallando a las familias texanas en cada paso, y con los devastadores recortes a Medicaid y SNAP inminentes, sigue la línea del Partido Republicano y actúa como un simple portavoz de MAGA.
Ayúdanos a luchar contra estos recortes.
Llena está forma para llamar a tu congresista y enviarle un correo electrónico exigiéndole que se oponga a TODOS los recortes a Medicaid y SNAP. [https://everytexan.salsalabs.org/ProtectMedicaidandSNAPNow/index.html]
Para obtener más información sobre el trabajo de TOP por la justicia sanitaria y cómo puedes unirte, contacta a Irie en ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] .
CONTACTE A SU REPRESENTANTE ESTATAL:
Mantenga la presión contra los proyectos de ley anti-inquilinos HB32 y SB38
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Eviction%20notice%20sticker.jpg]
La HB32 [https://www.expressnews.com/opinion/editorial/article/texas-house-bill-32-squatter-eviction-20227578.php] y su contraparte en el Senado, la SB38 [https://www.cbsnews.com/texas/news/fight-against-squatters-could-bring-faster-evictions-for-all-texas-renters/] , son proyectos de ley anti-inquilinos que socavan las protecciones de los inquilinos, dificultando aún más la lucha contra los desalojos. Estos proyectos de ley permiten a los propietarios desalojar a los inquilinos sin previo aviso ni procedimientos legales por razones distintas al impago del alquiler, lo que permite sentencias sin audiencia en algunos casos.
Si los autores de estos proyectos de ley afirman que abordarán el problema de la ocupación ilegal, en realidad vulneran el derecho al debido proceso de los inquilinos y perjudicarán a los tejanos que ya tienen dificultades para llegar a fin de mes. Estas leyes no se centran en los ocupantes ilegales; son herramientas para acelerar los desalojos y silenciar a la clase trabajadora tejana que lucha contra el desplazamiento injusto.
Juntos, podemos agotar el tiempo de estos proyectos de ley negativos, pero necesitamos su ayuda.
¡LLAME a su representante estatal y senador para instarlos a que se opongan a la HB32 y la SB38! [https://www.texastribune.org/directory/]
Felicitando a una organización socia por una gran noticia
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PPTV%20Shellie%20graphic.jpg]
¡Únete con nosotros para apoyar a Shellie Hayes-McMahon en su nuevo cargo como Directora Ejecutiva de Planned Parenthood Texas Votes! Este es una gran cosa para nuestro estado y para nuestro movimiento, ya que es la primera vez que la organización ha sido liderada exclusivamente por una mujer negra.
Texas es la zona cero de la prohibición del aborto, y ahora, con Shellie al frente de PPTV, tenemos una voz poderosa aún más presente en la lucha.
El liderazgo, la experiencia y la visión audaz de Shellie llegan en un momento crucial para la lucha por la libertad reproductiva en Texas y más allá. ¡Felicitaciones de parte del Equipo TOP, Shellie!
Consejos de TOP: Vaya a las urnas, Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Texas%20vote.jpg]
¡Ya están en marcha las elecciones locales en todo el estado! La votación anticipada comenzó el martes 22 de abril y se extenderá hasta el martes 29 de abril. El día de las elecciones es el sábado 3 de mayo. TODAS las elecciones importan e impactan a nuestras comunidades. HAGA CLIC AQUÍ para obtener más información sobre estas elecciones y lo que aparecerá en su boleta. [https://www.texastribune.org/2025/04/01/texas-local-voter-guide-2025-san-antonio-denton-el-paso-dallas/]

# **Fox News reporter CALLS OUT Democrat for sudden devotion to justice system**
Fox News host Will Cain **[ripped into Florida Democratic Congressman Maxwell Frost](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about recent liberal outcry for alleged MS-13 gang member and illegal immigrant Kilmar Abrego Garcia.
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Frost, along with four other Democratic lawmakers, visited El Salvador last week to advocate for the recently deported Abrego Garcia.
"He did not have due process. He was given a protective status, and the fact of the matter is that Donald Trump talked about doing the same thing to U.S. citizens just about less than a week ago," Frost said.
Frost's monologue about Trump's approach to justice, and the Supreme Court's suggestion to bring Garcia "home" came to a screeching halt when Cain stepped in.
**["He's an illegal alien. He is an alleged gang member of a foreign terrorist organization, and he was ordered removed,"](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Cain said.
Cain called out Frost with his own words, bringing up his previous statements challenging the legitimacy of the Supreme Court.
"You called the Supreme Court of the United States 'illegitimate!' Here today, all of the sudden, you seem to be very dedicated, principled in fact, to the simple rules of law, due process and legitimacy of the Court!" Cain said.
**[See Frost react to his blatant hypocrisy in the full video:](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/27f09ab6-0f21-4551-8f82-8c3839c7a6c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
# JD Vance ABSOLUTELY NAILS Abrego Garcia question from reporter
Vice President JD Vance gave the perfect answer when a reporter pressed him on the deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia and if he had a message for the illegal immigrant's wife.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/93fd7708-a91c-4c0f-b36b-9fb3bc6ba740?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Well I don't have a message for his wife but look, I just disagree wit the idea that he hasn't been offered due process," Vance explained. "He had a couple of immigration hearings, he had a valid deportation order. The idea that we couldn't deport an MS-13 gang member, and he was an MS-13 gang member, is preposterous!"
Vance continued to say that activist judges are attempting to "layer so much 'process' on top of the immigration system that it makes it impossible to function."

body:
| | |
Our democracy is under threat, and the most effective way to defend it is by winning elections at the local level. Local elected officials stand on the front lines, wielding the power to shape our communities and our future. _Yet, these critical races often go unnoticed, allowing extremism to take root._ Our Republican opponents have recognized the importance of local governance and have strategically invested in these elections to further their agenda. To safeguard our communities and democracy, we must exceed their efforts by supporting progressive candidates. Take Liz, a school board member in Minnesota, as an example of grassroots leadership. With just a $2,500 investment, she secured **_two_** terms, illustrating how even a modest contribution can create monumental change. With her governance, the district has strengthened a $125 million budget, modernized facilities, expanded learning opportunities, and enacted policies that protect LGBTQ+ students' rights, truthful history and intellectual freedom. Her achievements highlight the transformative potential of local governance and _a significant return on investment!_ This election cycle, Local Democracy Project aims to target 100 local races across the country and raise $770,000 to empower candidates who will champion progressive values. By investing in these leaders, we can create a powerful network of change-makers dedicated to uplifting our communities, standing up to authoritarianism and restoring democracy. **[Join us in this essential mission. name: Chris Pappas
subject: I’m running for Senate
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRIS DELUZIO FOR CONGRESS
body:
I’ll always put New Hampshire first.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106415111/541455177/1655103454?refcode=email_042425_deluziopappas&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI0NDU4OC0xNjIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MHLsicV6rWjGDEfo6pwIl--EYq4aFWDtxc3RLcvW5AA=) Derek, I’m Congressman Chris Pappas, and Chris Deluzio said I could reach out with some big news: **I’m officially running to be New Hampshire’s next U.S. Senator.** I’m going to share more about why I’m in this race, but if you’re already on board, **[split a contribution to my campaign and Chris Deluzio today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106415112/541455178/1655103454?refcode=email_042425_deluziopappas&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI0NDU4OC0xNjIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MHLsicV6rWjGDEfo6pwIl--EYq4aFWDtxc3RLcvW5AA=)** I’m running for Senate because at this pivotal moment, our economy, our democracy, and our way of life are on the line. New Hampshire deserves a Senator who is grounded in the people, places, and values of this state – and one who is ready to lead on day one. Our country is at a crossroads, and the decisions we make now will have generational impacts. You can count on me to continue taking on big fights and to confront the Trump Administration, self-dealing billionaires, and extreme politicians who are threatening our future and our ability to get things done for New Hampshire. **[Derek, can I count on you to become a Founding Donor to my campaign with a $5 contribution, split between my campaign and Chris Deluzio right now? We can’t win this race without major grassroots support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106415113/541455179/1655103454?refcode=email_042425_deluziopappas&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI0NDU4OC0xNjIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MHLsicV6rWjGDEfo6pwIl--EYq4aFWDtxc3RLcvW5AA=)** **These fights are deeply personal to me.** My family immigrated from Greece and opened a restaurant in Manchester 108 years ago, a small business that remains at the heart of the community today. Running that small business showed me the power of hard work and serving others, but the opportunity that my ancestors and so many others like them sought has never been further away – and the Trump Administration is too busy cutting deals for their billionaire buddies to give a damn. I’m also openly gay and happily married to my husband, Vann. With the current wave of hateful policies leveled at the LGBTQ+ community, I know how important representation is at this moment. **If elected, I’d be the first openly gay male U.S. Senator in history** – a badge of honor I’d wear proudly as I advocate for full equality. I am the proud product of public education, and I come from a family of business owners _(my grandfather invented the chicken tender at the restaurant – seriously!)_. I understand firsthand the need to support neighborhood schools and small businesses in our community. **These are the lifeblood of our economy and the pillars of opportunity for everyone.** My life experiences are what led me to successfully run for four terms in Congress and win in one of the “swingiest” districts in the nation. Before I won my election in 2018, no one had managed to hold the seat for more than one term for more than a decade. I’m no stranger to tough electoral fights. **Now I’m ready to take on the fight to keep New Hampshire’s Senate seat blue.** We can’t afford to sit on the sidelines of the big fights ahead – not with so much at stake, from the rising costs debilitating working families to the threats to the future of our democracy. We’ve taken on big fights together in Congress. Now it’s time to win this critical Senate seat so we can keep standing up to the Trump Administration and the self-dealing billionaires threatening our future. Can I count on you to join the fight? **[Derek, if you’re with me, let’s make a powerful statement together and prove that we’re ready to win this race. Become a Founding Donor with a $5 donation to my campaign and Chris Deluzio now.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/106415114/541455180/1655103454?refcode=email_042425_deluziopappas&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDI0NDU4OC0xNjIxLWYwMTEtOGIzZC0wMDIyNDgyYTlmYjciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MHLsicV6rWjGDEfo6pwIl--EYq4aFWDtxc3RLcvW5AA=)** Thank you again to Chris Deluzio for letting me reach out today. With gratitude,

Chris

body:

| | Fellow Conservative,Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zqm7tfa390je1u4bi88a8v1e3palchhvvraj8qto_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli61pb4cjh2bs)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_.But today, all that has changed.The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.”Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series.And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA.And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion.The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse.But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.”That may be good for your family – for now.But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values!**[**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zpjugaiouccds2nmmchnjuhor6p4fk7tf3e9cc3g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli61pb4cjh2bs)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.”I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood.But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian.When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit.And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own.
