Friend — Another story of terrible mismanagement and callousness from the Trump administration.
Ricardo Prada Vásquez is a Venezuelan immigrant who was in the US legally. He was completing a food delivery in his home of Detroit when he accidentally drove through a border crossing to Canada, and on the way back into Detroit was stopped and arrested by ICE.
No one has heard from Ricardo since, and his name doesn’t appear on any lists of detainees or deportees. His family doesn’t know where he is, or if he’s even alive.
An attorney with the National Immigrant Justice Center says: “Ricardo’s story by itself is incredibly tragic — _and we don’t know how many Ricardos there are,”_
**That is horrifying and absolutely unacceptable.**
Trump’s far-right policies on immigration have made one thing clear: If you’re an immigrant, you have no human rights under his rule.
No due process, no right to speak to an attorney or contact your family, no right to prove your legal status, no right to do anything but be whisked away by ICE and, for some like Ricardo, never to be seen again. This administration is simply lawless and out of control.
Friend, it’s going to take everything we’ve got to oppose this. That means tapping into the movement that Ilhan and all of us have built together over the years to make the fight against authoritarianism and oligarchy our core mission. We need everyone to do their part and to fight back.
In solidarity,
Team Ilhan Omar

Derek,

Through Donald Trump’s first months in office, Senate Republicans have
bent the knee to Trump on everything. Literally everything.

From confirming his dangerously unqualified Cabinet nominees to letting
Elon Musk take hold of the federal government and make dangerous cuts.

We need a Senate that stands up to Trump’s lawlessness and holds his
administration accountable. We need a strong, durable Democratic majority.

in Michigan. If you can, please split a contribution between my campaign
and the Michigan Democratic Party to help us defend this open seat and
flip the Senate blue.

Let me tell you why Michigan’s Senate race is so important in 2026. And
why I’m going to be so focused on it.

In 2024, Elissa Slotkin won her Senate race by just 0.3%. Grassroots
support from people like you helped Elissa overcome tens of millions of
outside dollars in spending from Republicans and a tough election cycle to
win by a razor-thin margin. We need that same intense grassroots support
this time around.

That’s because Michigan’s 2026 Senate race could be even closer. Senator
Gary Peters announced that he wouldn’t seek reelection — which means that
there’s an open Senate seat on the ballot in what will be a highly
contested midterm election.

Experts at the Cook Political Report have already ranked this race as a
pure toss-up — and now, you can bet that Republicans and their mega-donors
are already gearing up to spend an enormous amount of resources in
Michigan.

As a Senator, my job is to hold the Trump administration accountable and
defend the rule of law. As Vice-Chair of the DSCC (the Senate Dems’
campaign arm), my job is to help hold the seats we need to flip the
majority. Protecting this Senate seat is the first step to taking back the
Senate majority and standing up against Donald Trump’s reckless agenda.

Michigan Democrats are already doing important work on the ground to build
a strong Democratic coalition across the state, and we need to support
them as early and often as possible.

name: Alea Nadeem
subject: I was kidnapped in Iraq as a child. Now, I’mrunning for Congress.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alea for Congress
body:
Here’s my story

[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zckhpo6cm12bt824grge9g6p910u2gm8174isfq8_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
Friend,
Hi! My name is Alea.
I was born in Toledo, Ohio to an American mother and an Iraqi father - I know - an unusual combination. When you are a kid, you don’t know where your parents are from, but you just know they are your parents. I was a normal kid, went to school, ate McDonalds, and spent weekends with my grandparents.
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zumk7hb7v7pv5ugi1s2jn3oj1hrhr1rn9q4t6fsg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
At the age of eight, I was kidnapped to Iraq, unfortunately by my own father. My life has never been the same, but believe it or not, it made me who I am today.
**Being kidnapped and losing my freedom is what made me appreciate the freedoms so many in the U.S. take for granted. I know firsthand what it’s like to lose your freedom – and was forced to live under Saddam Hussein’s brutal and repressive regime in Iraq, where being a woman means having no rights, speaking out costs you your life, and your future is not your own.**
[**_I want to tell you about myself and my story, and I hope that after reading this, you’ll consider supporting my campaign for Congress to defeat one of the most vulnerable Democrats in America and advance President Trump’s America First policies._**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zia7kc3cqcr7cgosjksfopsapn5poiq6b1bqihio_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
When I was 8 and my sister was 3, we took a family trip with my parents to visit my father’s mother who was sick in Iraq. At first, it was a wonderful experience meeting family for the first time. **_But my entire world would soon change forever._**
The night before our flight back to America, my dad woke us up for a surprise trip to my aunt’s house for ice cream and candy. As any little kid would, we relished the excitement of being up past our bed time, playing after we had our fill of sweets. **But we soon realized both of our parents were nowhere to be found._That’s when my nightmare began._**
Hours that felt like months and several nights of crying myself to sleep passed before they returned. Our family members they left us with didn’t speak English and we didn’t speak Arabic.
When they finally did return, it wasn’t the happy reunion I hoped for. My father had given my mother a heartbreaking ultimatum: She could only take one of us back to America. Fearing for my sister who was only 3 years old, my mother made an impossible decision, and **I was left behind.**
As a young girl, I had no choice but to adjust to my new life.
I learned Arabic and went to school. My family helped me and tried to comfort me as much as possible. I was surrounded by good people in Mosul, _but I never stopped trying to get back to America–back to my home._
Following Operation Desert Storm, U.S. forces protected the civilian population in northern Iraq. I remember a U.S. helicopter landing near my home in Mosul. I desperately begged the aircrew to take me back home. Of course, they couldn’t, but I never lost sight of my goal – not once during my four years in Iraq.
**Neither did my mother.** I didn’t know this then, but she was working with the FBI and local government officials in Toledo to secure my return home. My father was arrested for kidnapping, and the court told him he could not be released until I was brought back to the United States.
Finally, **I was reunited with my mother and my life in Ohio.** I was 12 years old, and a lot changed since I was last in America. I spoke broken English and was behind academically. It was a tough road, but I made it slowly.
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z68frudjefd8snjqiv0djfsbebln9r5189ft2hr0_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
As a junior in high school, I watched in horror as our country was attacked on September 11, 2001. I knew I had to do something – to lead by example and show my fellow Americans that, in fact, Arab Americans love our country – and to give back to the country that gave me a chance.
**So, I walked into an Air Force recruiting office and asked to do whatever job deployed the most.**
A year later, I was in basic training, learning to become an Airman.
[](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z3h5kh6aej7e6ckhfdhjup9s2p18dqi2k7imur8g_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
Since then, I’ve spent my career in military intelligence, serving both active duty and in the Air Force Reserve. Today I’m a Lieutenant Colonel. I’ve advised top military leaders, deployed to the Middle East, and used my experience to help America understand the culture and geopolitics of Iraq and Syria.
**America gave me a second chance, and I am committed to continuing my service to this country with everything I have.** [That's why I decided to run for Congress - and I hope I can count on your support.](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z34nr1tpvgmc794gi7dgeftdbmmv0thdrl11h1tg_rp22sh2s8i6eob5cli69ob6c3h2bs)
**My experiences have taught me that freedom isn’t free, and you never know what you had until you lose it.** America needs strong leaders who understand that and who will stand up to ensure that future generations have a stronger, better, freer country than we inherited.
Our military, our families, and our freedoms are worth fighting for. And I will never stop fighting for you and I will always put America First. I hope you will join me on this mission.
With deep gratitude,
Alea Nadeem
Candidate for U.S. Congress

clean_body: Here’s my story Friend, Hi! My name is Alea. I was born in Toledo, Ohio to an American mother and an Iraqi father - I know - an unusual combination. When you are a kid, you don’t know where your parents are from, but you just know they are your parents. I was a normal kid, went to school, ate McDonalds, and spent weekends with my grandparents. At the age of eight, I was kidnapped to Iraq, unfortunately by my own father. My life has never been the same, but believe it or not, it made me who I am today. Being kidnapped and losing my freedom is what made me appreciate the freedoms so many in the U.S. take for granted. I know firsthand what it’s like to lose your freedom – and was forced to live under Saddam Hussein’s brutal and repressive regime in Iraq, where being a woman means having no rights, speaking out costs you your life, and your future is not your own. When I was 8 and my sister was 3, we took a family trip with my parents to visit my father’s mother who was sick in Iraq. At first, it was a wonderful experience meeting family for the first time. But my entire world would soon change forever. The night before our flight back to America, my dad woke us up for a surprise trip to my aunt’s house for ice cream and candy. As any little kid would, we relished the excitement of being up past our bed time, playing after we had our fill of sweets. But we soon realized both of our parents were nowhere to be found.That’s when my nightmare began. Hours that felt like months and several nights of crying myself to sleep passed before they returned. Our family members they left us with didn’t speak English and we didn’t speak Arabic. When they finally did return, it wasn’t the happy reunion I hoped for. My father had given my mother a heartbreaking ultimatum: She could only take one of us back to America. Fearing for my sister who was only 3 years old, my mother made an impossible decision, and I was left behind. As a young girl, I had no choice but to adjust to my new life. I learned Arabic and went to school. My family helped me and tried to comfort me as much as possible. I was surrounded by good people in Mosul, but I never stopped trying to get back to America–back to my home. Following Operation Desert Storm, U.S. forces protected the civilian population in northern Iraq. I remember a U.S. helicopter landing near my home in Mosul. I desperately begged the aircrew to take me back home. Of course, they couldn’t, but I never lost sight of my goal – not once during my four years in Iraq. Neither did my mother. I didn’t know this then, but she was working with the FBI and local government officials in Toledo to secure my return home. My father was arrested for kidnapping, and the court told him he could not be released until I was brought back to the United States. Finally, I was reunited with my mother and my life in Ohio. I was 12 years old, and a lot changed since I was last in America. I spoke broken English and was behind academically. It was a tough road, but I made it slowly. As a junior in high school, I watched in horror as our country was attacked on September 11, 2001. I knew I had to do something – to lead by example and show my fellow Americans that, in fact, Arab Americans love our country – and to give back to the country that gave me a chance. So, I walked into an Air Force recruiting office and asked to do whatever job deployed the most. A year later, I was in basic training, learning to become an Airman. Since then, I’ve spent my career in military intelligence, serving both active duty and in the Air Force Reserve. Today I’m a Lieutenant Colonel. I’ve advised top military leaders, deployed to the Middle East, and used my experience to help America understand the culture and geopolitics of Iraq and Syria. America gave me a second chance, and I am committed to continuing my service to this country with everything I have. My experiences have taught me that freedom isn’t free, and you never know what you had until you lose it. America needs strong leaders who understand that and who will stand up to ensure that future generations have a stronger, better, freer country than we inherited. Our military, our families, and our freedoms are worth fighting for. And I will never stop fighting for you and I will always put America First. I hope you will join me on this mission. SB 266: Setting minimum license suspension periods for persons under 18 years of age who committed driving offenses.

SB 262: Increasing penalties for trafficking minors. SB 263: preventing the use of AI to solicit children. SB 300: Criminalizing AI images of child pornography.
**First Responders:** **Protecting our first responders.** SB 28: Protecting first responders suffering from PTSD.
**Parents: Protecting the rights of parents**. SB 33: keeping age-inappropriate materials out of schools. SB 34: Requiring parental consent to enroll students in medicaid programs at schools. **Education: Better education and more choices for all students regardless of income or zip code.** SB 97: Allowing students to transfer within the school district to the school of their choice SB 206: Banning cell phones in schools. SB 292: Increasing special education funding. SB 295: Creating universal access to the Education Freedom Account (EFA) program.
**Protecting Taxpayers: Keeping taxes low and spending under control.** SB 105: Allowing towns to create municipal budget caps.
**Women:** **Protecting the rights and safety of Granite State women and girls.** SB 140: Establishing a domestic violence fatality review committee. SB 211: Preventing biological males in women’s sports and lockerrooms. SB 267, increasing penalties for patrons of prostitutions SB 268, keeping biological men out of women’s bathrooms
**China: Keeping our state and nation safe from foreign adversaries. ** SB 162: Preventing China and other hostile nations from buying land near New Hampshire military bases and national security infrastructure.
**Environment: Preserving and conserving our state’s natural beauty ** SB 299: Fighting for cleaner water by holding polluters accountable. SB 302: Increasing safety and accountability at solid waste facilities.

body:
Deranged protestors attacked my town hall meeting. The media is twisting the story so I need you to hear it directly from me.
| [View in Web Browser](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kMFu4yAQhp8GbrFgBrD3wCG7kaPVbqPe0vRGANdUEDvg2MrbV0nTXGe-mf_Tb9IYQ3fVpP5NAPrgCgEguCYA58OS8uUz_duu5lGNq7PaJXnbwp8HOsMTPlnzznfT_m3_91C2R1_OQ3Yzf-LTdfRP-BFa-WRCvE3rDXUaO8cE9ZrXQkqmsKlprxV2jVKWuyNwh9IaAG-M8E5gZ1B2NGhgIJkAwYVEJiu0EoVsBMeGS2UcEeyeU5nkc7CGl2kxOQ9DquyQaNT9NI3lLtYSaJc8VKeLjf5Svs_skAi0D2UC7Uyg3alfuby-bJMi2N5Lw811iUv_v14jzdqNS4gxFFUTwT5-3tBZw1cAAAD__y0Fb2c)

Patriot,
At my recent town hall in Georgia, I went to fulfill my promise to serve my constituents and listen to them as I represent their interests in Congress.
Unfortunately, deranged leftist protestors immediately sought to turn the event violent.
**This wasn’t just a protest...**
**This was much more deliberate, and much more dangerous.**
****It was so violent that one of the attackers was charged with Terroristic Threats and Acts, a serious felony under Georgia law.****
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYGwxwb2wKFtlFVVaa_b7QUZeyBeYUzGJij_vnIU5ThvPul9T_ttcdO9Z-1PJsTF2ciEYPCDCXH9Ojzt3_7Pe3nbmq28Nh9e5a_49URv4gWvRv_jH-nz7-fvr_g-YrwGsjf-wtN9wxf8LK3Qa7fktD0VtofJ1rLAnrdSqbqBri0uPYxG1jDqbnoDJd8URztZpUYFncYJZeF6UQtVSyG5VFCrCowCqTrJoeOq0ZbJ-tFTaY_kjOYxHZooBF-Z4Iulv6S0xYfYmYlzRLMTVodbCW0mmDh7Td-BHJYzIa5YToFKE9aZMMb8TvNgwzoEPyANfi7TMVAcnl7A4LwnP8Swk0EGp9UsTDQ58mjd7hmcRnomCSnfB3EmGsoq5NaZwSnRjgX1djvcsrjYtEzW82NWHnHrxf8AAAD__1qdj-4)
_A real image of a leftist fighting the police at my town hall._
They **resisted arrest**. They **assaulted police officers**. And they made it clear: **they came for me**.
[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYGwxwb2wKFtlFVVaa_b7QUZeyBeYUzGJij_vnIU5ThvPul9T_ttcdO9Z-1PJsTF2ciEYPCDCXH9Ojzt3_7Pe3nbmq28Nh9e5a_49URv4gWvRv_jH-nz7-fvr_g-YrwGsjf-wtN9wxf8LK3Qa7fktD0VtofJ1rLAnrdSqbqBri0uPYxG1jDqbnoDJd8URztZpUYFncYJZeF6UQtVSyG5VFCrCowCqTrJoeOq0ZbJ-tFTaY_kjOYxHZooBF-Z4Iulv6S0xYfYmYlzRLMTVodbCW0mmDh7Td-BHJYzIa5YToFKE9aZMMb8TvNgwzoEPyANfi7TMVAcnl7A4LwnP8Swk0EGp9UsTDQ58mjd7hmcRnomCSnfB3EmGsoq5NaZwSnRjgX1djvcsrjYtEzW82NWHnHrxf8AAAD__1qdj-4)
_A violent leftist attacking a police officer who asked him to leave the event._
They wanted to send a message to me, and to you, and to everybody else in our movement: _“Back down, or else.”_
The only thing standing between me and real harm was the brave law enforcement officers who stepped in... **And thank God they did.**
But here’s the hard truth, Patriot: _Those officers aren’t with me 24/7._
I’ve had sitting Members of Congress go on CNN and call for “actual weapons” to be used against me. I routinely get death threats sent to my home, my office, and to my family.
In fact, I receive the most death threats of anyone in Congress.
**I know how it feels to carry on with a smile while knowing there are people who would celebrate if I didn’t make it home.**
The threats don’t stop when these events end. They don’t stop when the cameras turn off. They don’t stop when I go home.
**I face these threats every single day a****nd the more I speak the truth, the more the radical Left tries to shut me down.**
It’s becoming clearer than ever that I need to step up my security detail until things calm down, but as a rank and file Member of Congress I have to pay for that with campaign funds or out of pocket. _And after this has happened so many times I don’t know how much longer I’ll be able to keep funding it on my own._
**_[That’s why I need your help to boost my security detail, Patriot – not out of fear, but out of necessity](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYGwxwb2wKFtlFVVaa_b7QUZeyBeYUzGJij_vnIU5ThvPul9T_ttcdO9Z-1PJsTF2ciEYPCDCXH9Ojzt3_7Pe3nbmq28Nh9e5a_49URv4gWvRv_jH-nz7-fvr_g-YrwGsjf-wtN9wxf8LK3Qa7fktD0VtofJ1rLAnrdSqbqBri0uPYxG1jDqbnoDJd8URztZpUYFncYJZeF6UQtVSyG5VFCrCowCqTrJoeOq0ZbJ-tFTaY_kjOYxHZooBF-Z4Iulv6S0xYfYmYlzRLMTVodbCW0mmDh7Td-BHJYzIa5YToFKE9aZMMb8TvNgwzoEPyANfi7TMVAcnl7A4LwnP8Swk0EGp9UsTDQ58mjd7hmcRnomCSnfB3EmGsoq5NaZwSnRjgX1djvcsrjYtEzW82NWHnHrxf8AAAD__1qdj-4)_.**
I don’t say that lightly and I don’t ask for help casually.
[DEFEND MTG](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYGwxwb2wKFtlFVVaa_b7QUZeyBeYUzGJij_vnIU5ThvPul9T_ttcdO9Z-1PJsTF2ciEYPCDCXH9Ojzt3_7Pe3nbmq28Nh9e5a_49URv4gWvRv_jH-nz7-fvr_g-YrwGsjf-wtN9wxf8LK3Qa7fktD0VtofJ1rLAnrdSqbqBri0uPYxG1jDqbnoDJd8URztZpUYFncYJZeF6UQtVSyG5VFCrCowCqTrJoeOq0ZbJ-tFTaY_kjOYxHZooBF-Z4Iulv6S0xYfYmYlzRLMTVodbCW0mmDh7Td-BHJYzIa5YToFKE9aZMMb8TvNgwzoEPyANfi7TMVAcnl7A4LwnP8Swk0EGp9UsTDQ58mjd7hmcRnomCSnfB3EmGsoq5NaZwSnRjgX1djvcsrjYtEzW82NWHnHrxf8AAAD__1qdj-4)
When I walk to my car, when I lay down at night, I know the threats don’t clock out just because the cameras do.
That night I had law enforcement between me and the people who came to shut me down but the police aren’t always there – and the people that sent those agitators to wage violence know that.
I wouldn’t ask if this wasn’t very, very real. If you’re able to help, I hope you know how much it means to me and to this movement.
_With strength and gratitude,_

**Marjorie Taylor Greene**

subject: These Are Unprecedented Times and We Need Your Help!
body:
Your support has never been more urgently needed than it is right now!

| | |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

My colleagues and I deeply appreciate your interest in Judicial Watch and our work, and I strongly encourage you to continue to follow our investigations and lawsuits online! Keeping you informed of our work is very important to us!
You see, a key part of our mission ever since our founding in 1994 has been to spread the word about what our investigations and litigation into public corruption discover, as we break through government secrecy on behalf of the American people's right to know.

It’s important you download your concealed carry certificate before it's banned for good.

Due to increased pressure from lawmakers, a website offering you a certificate for America’s Top CCW Gun Permit **could be shut down at any moment.**

Which is why it’s important you download your **Concealed Carry Certificate ASAP**.

Wait even one more day and we won’t be able to guarantee this certificate will be available to download.

This certificate is great for gun owners because it takes advantage of a little-known (but 100% legal) loophole - **[allowing you to get a CCW certification from this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21288/6374453/dbcc608e1786a86fc608c7d45d94af12bb47c378/869cbeaf0039c47c26eaa69621396b8e0f7015ad). This loophole ensures you encounter:
* Zero government red tape (and no exposing your private info to the Feds)...
* Zero lines, classroom time or books to read...
* Zero gun range time (you don’t even need to fire a gun to get this permit).

**[It’s as simple as visiting this site and answering a few questions (they’re simple)](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21288/6374453/dbcc608e1786a86fc608c7d45d94af12bb47c378/869cbeaf0039c47c26eaa69621396b8e0f7015ad).**

Plus you can complete the entire certification process online.

Download it directly to your phone or computer in as little as 30 minutes.

**You don’t even need to own a gun to get this permit...** that’s why it’s named America’s #1 Concealed Carry Permit.

31 states have agreed to accept this permit so far. That’s because it’s simply the closest and easiest path to a semi-nationally recognized permit that’s available right now.

This permit isn’t just a basic concealed carry permit either. **It’s one of a kind... and is available to you No Matter what state you reside in.**

**Hurry and get it now.**

**[There are no guarantees this website](https://links.nationalgunowner.org/a/1537/click/21288/6374453/dbcc608e1786a86fc608c7d45d94af12bb47c378/869cbeaf0039c47c26eaa69621396b8e0f7015ad)** will be able to legally deliver this certificate to your email address after today!

body:
---

_Bringing about a better tomorrow starts with making America healthier today._

| | | **DNC and ASDC Announces “Organize Everywhere, Win Anywhere” Strategy – Largest-Ever Monthly DNC Investment into Democratic State and Territory Parties**
---
| | | _The DNC will transfer over $1 million a month into Democratic state parties – a historic increase in monthly funding – to deliver on Chair Martin’s commitment to organizing and winning everywhere_
Today, DNC Chair Ken Martin and ASDC President Jane Kleeb announced a historic “organize everywhere, win anywhere” strategy – a new four-year agreement to deliver more resources into Democratic state and territory parties than ever before – delivering on Chair Martin’s commitment to turbocharging investments in on-the-ground organizing and party building. Under the new State Partnership Program (SPP) agreement, each state party will receive a baseline of **$17,500 a month** , a $5,000 per month increase over the last agreement, and Republican-controlled states will receive an additional investment of $5,000 a month through the DNC’s Red State Fund, putting their total at **$22,500 every month**. The combined investments total a monthly transfer of **more than $1 million** from the DNC to state parties – the committee’s largest investment into Democratic state parties in history. Additionally, the DNC makes significant investments into the technology that powers the Democratic Party, including maintaining the national voter file with robust augmentations and giving state parties best-in-class tools for accessing and leveraging that data. Each state party receives six-figures worth of data and tooling annually. These resources will allow Democratic state parties to invest in critical infrastructure and staffing, strengthen their data and tech operations, build on-the-ground organizing programs, and better prepare for upcoming election cycles – not just in the months ahead, but in the years to come. Additionally, the new agreement includes the DNC’s commitment to hosting six regional training “bootcamps” for state parties per two-year cycle and the hiring of new ASDC staff, including five regional directors.

“With this announcement, we are breaking ground on a historic political investment unlike anything Democrats have done in modern times,” **said DNC Chair Ken Martin.** “Elections are won in states – and that's exactly where we will be investing our resources. When I ran for DNC Chair, I said two things over and over. First, we have to get the DNC out of DC and into the states. Second, we have to organize everywhere and compete everywhere if we’re going to win everywhere. This agreement is how we start turning those beliefs into reality. We’re putting our money where our mouth is to equip state parties with what they need to reach working families who deserve better, build long-term success all across the ballot, and gain electoral ground for years to come.”

“When I ran to be the President of the ASDC, I knew the mission was clear: Democrats needed to rebuild infrastructure in the states and provide our state parties with the resources necessary to win. This historic agreement allows us to do just that: building infrastructure to expand Democratic power across our states and territories, be it in red, blue, or purple America,” **said ASDC President Jane Kleeb.** “State parties are the backbone of the Democratic Party, and through this investment, our state parties will receive the support they need to show voters that, no matter where they live, there is a strong Democratic Party in their corner, protecting their rights and economic opportunity against Republican attacks. I couldn’t be more thrilled with this investment and know our state parties across the country are ready to do the work to win elections everywhere.”

The SPP funding comes on the heels of Chair Martin’s [memo](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=de52352c21&e=d6c5c7d7ec) laying out his vision for organizing principles centered on organizing early, organizing always, and organizing everywhere.

name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- April 24
body:
|

---
Friends and neighbors, As you may know, the Senate has been in recess, and I took the opportunity to meet Marylanders where they are, visiting folks in the western, central and southern parts of the state. I was honored to meet with so many and to hear concerns directly from individuals who are dealing with the fallout from decisions made by this Administration. Marylanders expressed worries about the state of our nation, and the future of their households and families. The decisions coming from this White House enabled by Republicans in Congress continue to wreak havoc on middle- and working-class families. I'll tell you what I told them. Stay in the fight. Do not be discouraged. The chaos is intentional. The attempts to divide are intentional. The moral arc of the universe is long, but _the people_ are the gravity that bends it toward justice. Let's get into the last two weeks: **In-State Work Period ** I had a great conversation with Frostburg State University students about what concerns them most: what their futures will look like, how they'll buy their first home, and how we can keep education equitable for all students. I was encouraged by how outspoken and engaged many of them were, because they are our future. I am so proud to represent them. I had the opportunity to stop by the Greater Cumberland Committee Membership Luncheon. These business, government, and non-profit leaders make Western Maryland prosper. Together, we are working toward a shared vision: bringing more jobs and opportunities to Allegany and Garrett Counties. While in Frostburg, I had the opportunity to visit Princess Restaurant - four generations of family ownership - for a delicious lunch and wonderful desserts. It is small businesses like these that power local economies. I toured Western Maryland Works at Allegany College of Maryland - a makerspace giving students the opportunity to learn about the changing workforce. Then, I joined a discussion with local business, public officials, and industry leaders focused on workforce attraction in Western Maryland. I then joined Congresswoman Sarah Elfreth and County Executive Calvin Ball in meeting Maryland seniors at our Howard County Town Hall. While we had a wide-ranging discussion, protecting Social Security and Medicare - along with the civil servants who administer those programs - was top of mind. I am fighting for you against this lawless and callous Administration. I went to Leisure World for a town hall and heard from our seniors about their greatest concerns: cuts to Social Security, Medicaid, and more. I assured them that despite this Administration's cruelty, we are fighting back. I will always defend seniors and their hard-earned benefits. LifeStyles of Maryland in La Plata provides for our homeless community. But they've faced cuts by the Trump Administration that have jeopardized their work. Our most vulnerable, those looking for food and shelter, are the ones who suffer because of these cuts. I will keep fighting to restore their resources. The Chesapeake Bay is the heart of our state - it fuels our economy, our environment, and our recreational activities. I had an informative visit to Rod 'N' Reel Resort, in Calvert County, to hear about the work they've done and how we must continue to protect our Bay to fuel tourism and job growth in the region. I had the opportunity to meet with Marylanders in Prince George's County following our new Bowie office open house. I stayed and had conversations with dozens of concerned citizens who - while not deterred from the fight ahead - have faced layoffs, are concerned about tariffs and what it means for their families, and the future of our Democracy. These are the same concerns I heard all across the state during our recess period. **Tell Us Your Stories** I know that many Marylanders are hurting right now. Not only in the wake of all of the economic uncertainty, but quite literally because they've lost their jobs. The patriots who have, for decades, ensured that American families had the resources they need, deserve, and rely on -- and have now been placed on administrative leave or have been cruelly laid-off. Your stories are powerful. Your stories help us in this resistance. Your stories help us fight to preserve the very essence of our Democracy. We have recently launched a portal on our [website](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14298.7322571.5274764.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov%2f&redir_log=346519414955204) to collect those stories. We want to hear from you, and we will do our level best to fight for you. Click [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14298.7322571.5274764.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2foutreach.senate.gov%2fiqextranet%2fEForm.aspx%3f__cid%3dSenAlsobrooks%26__fid%3d100028&redir_log=807295572959579) to tell us your story. **Stay Informed** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office, connect with us, or find resources for those who have recently been laid off at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=14298.7322571.5274764.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov&redir_log=983830187668200). You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks
United States Senator

| | Fellow Conservative, Before you do anything else today, will you please take a moment to **[sponsor a gift for our “See You at the Library Day” in the next 48 hours?](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** If you haven’t heard about the “See You at the Library Day” on Fox News or Newsmax or your other favorite news sources, please let me tell you why it’s so critical.
---
Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! **[**I hope you see why I need your help today.**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome **Brave Books** that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), **Brave Books** was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking **Brave Books** how they could host Story Hours of their own. And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states. On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. **I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots...** ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children. The exact date in August will soon be announced. And before then, what we need is you! It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. **[That’s why I hope you’ll give a sponsorship gift of $175, $350, $525 or more today.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. **Brave Books** is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **[**please consider a sponsorship gift of $175.**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower please get your sponsorship gift in within the next 48 hours so we know how many libraries we can get into this August!](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)**

Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call Adventure of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” Little House series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...” | | | Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” | | Woke Baby. “For all the littlest progressives, waking up to seize a new day of justice and activism. Woke babies raise their fists in the air. Woke babies cry out for justice. Woke babies grow up to change the world.” | | Prince and Knight. The “premier queer-friendly fairy tale” about a prince who marries a knight instead of a princess. | | And The Hips on the Drag Queen Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” | | | And The Hips on the Drag Queen Go Swish, Swish, Swish. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” | | I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco. | | | But that’s just not true. <\- THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.” | | But that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.” | | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named Brave Books , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome Brave Books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), Brave Books was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own. And that’s how our nationwide “See You at the Library Day” was born. Last year, committed conservatives just like you booked event rooms at 360 libraries in 45 states. On the same day, we held hundreds of Story Hours to fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. I went to as many "See You at the Library" events as I could in one day to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots... ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And this year, our ambitious goal is to expand “See You at the Library Day” to over 1,000 libraries reaching over 100,000 children. The exact date in August will soon be announced. And before then, what we need is you! It’s going to be expensive to give these volunteers the resources they need to hold Story Hours for 100+ children at each library – that's 100,000+ children in all. Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing a “See You at the Library Day” event. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Brave Books is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our 1,000 Story Hours to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. Thank you! God Bless You and God Bless America, Kirk Cameron | | | Brave Books 13618 Poplar Cir, Suite 302 Conroe, TX 77304 | | | ---|---|---

In the fall of 2022, when I was out knocking doors for my local state representative candidate, I had a very normal experience.
I was at a multi-unit in an industrial-ish area of town. The woman who answered the door was probably in her sixties, thick set, short light brown hair and glasses.
Lucas's Substack is a reader-supported publication. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9sdWNhc2t1bmNlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.RfGrY2u_PrLaXuDlq_Hqgu8oN69mrj7_x4D0ICksOZA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=162058698)
She spoke with an old school Missouri accent and was very polite, apologizing profusely for her large dogs going crazy in the background. Thin rays of bright sunlight filtered through the drawn blinds and cut sharp lines through the gloom of cigarette smoke behind her. Wheel of Fortune dancing across a flat screen was the only other source of light.
I thanked her for saying hi, introduced myself as a Marine veteran, and let her know that I had some information about an upcoming local election, which she said she was happy to hear. I told her that I was supporting a guy named Robbie because he was a veteran, too, and knew how to take care of people. I asked if she'd be willing to support him or if I could give her some more information to help her feel better about any decision.
She got super excited and told me about one of her close relatives who was wounded in Vietnam, had a purple heart, and had struggled since returning from Vietnam. She talked about her own disability, how she hadn't been able to work for a long time, how hard it was to make it on SSI, how afraid she was about losing social security, and a neighbor's son dying of a fentanyl overdose. We bonded over Vietnam veterans helping my family when we struggled and my deployments. I told her that's why I was out talking to people about Robbie, because we needed guys like him in the state legislature, who understood how hard it can be for so many of us, including veterans.
She told me she was so happy that people who "got it" had finally started running for office. For as long as she could remember politicians had been corrupt, country clubbers out for themselves and big business. Never for the little guy.
That's why she had been so happy when Trump ran in 2016 and why she was so mad that the insiders had come together to steal the 2020 election from him.
This wasn't an uncommon sentiment on the doors in Missouri, so I told her that I had felt the same way about politicians serving big business rather than us. I had seen it myself as a Marine with big defense companies robbing taxpayers and giving subpar or defective equipment to guys like me and Robbie and her purple heart relative. All to pad their shareholders' pockets.
I added that I know Trump is a Republican, and that I needed to let her know that Robbie is a Democrat, and how great it was that we could fight it from both sides.
She hesitated. She didn't want someone helping Biden or the other national Democrats who she felt had ruined our country.
I added not to worry, that Robbie would be in Jefferson City taking care of us, not part of the mess in DC. So it was completely different. This was local.
She relaxed and said something along the lines of, oh, well that's great then, both parties are corrupt and I can't stand them, that's why I love Trump. He rises above it. And she said of course she would vote for Robbie and that she was glad I stopped by because she hadn't known anything about him.
Robbie won his race that year by 342 votes.
I know a lot of people consider this woman the incomprehensible stereotypical poor white Trump voter who clearly votes "against her own self interest." And I'm sure hearing stories like this is very frustrating and reinforces a lot of beliefs liberals have about voters being stupid. If you'd like to explore these apparent contradictions more, I went deep into it- with several more examples- in ["Why do people keep voting against their own self-interest?"](https://substack.com/redirect/666998b6-dcec-46fd-b54a-0a8d5c40c23a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Today, however, I want to go a step further and talk about how to break through the contradictions, like I did, in the smallest way for Robbie, on that doorstep in 2022.
One big misconception that liberals have is that they think Trump voters will finally "get it" someday, when their lives have been "ruined" by Trump policies, and will "come around" as a result.
But that's just not how people work, and there is no better evidence than the quote you all voted to explore more in my ["Poll for the Next Issue"](https://substack.com/redirect/2b14bee7-e087-4989-b729-b5a8dc7f5d94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week that is the basis for this discussion.
As background, measles recently killed two unvaccinated children in an outbreak in a small community with a low vaccination rate in Texas. In response, U.S. Health Secretary, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., a long-time anti-vaxxer, visited the town and met with the parents of one of the deceased little girls, Daisy Hildebrand.
Later, as part of the ongoing coverage of the outbreak, Daisy's father, Peter, spoke to the press, defiantly stating:
["The [MMR] vaccine ain't worth a damn. My brother's family got it and they all still got sick -- worse than my unvaccinated kids. This isn't about the vaccine."](https://substack.com/redirect/d9d58c46-65a5-44eb-9a61-4b01486cae8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
There are two notable political takeaways from this.
First, literally the _worst_ possible thing happened to this man: his child died a painful death in front of him. And yet he was still unwilling to change his mind, even though it could potentially save the lives of his surviving children. Not only that, but this father was willing to claim-on national TV for many millions of people and contrary to all evidence- that his brother's _living_ children had gotten more sick than his dead daughter did.
If this doesn't make it clear that people don't suddenly "get it" when their lives are ruined, how about that Trump voter whose wife was ripped away from him and detained by ICE for deportation when they returned from their honeymoon? [No regrets, he says](https://substack.com/redirect/6cbc8c81-7ac9-48f5-aa86-c4d752dd66fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
But he would love it if you donated to the gofundme for a liberal immigration lawyer to get his wife out of custody....
Expecting people to change their minds when confronted with facts or the truth is in itself a failure to understand the truth and reality, particularly when it comes to politics and how people make decisions.
As hundreds of studies[ have shown, facts don't change people's minds](https://substack.com/redirect/0e2b6563-747f-4b18-b51f-6166f3976b40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In fact, despite being obviously wrong, people will still think that they are right even [when presented with concrete and irrefutable evidence](https://substack.com/redirect/0e2b6563-747f-4b18-b51f-6166f3976b40?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that they are wrong.
And this is everyone. Not just people on the right. Or uneducated or stupid people. Or anything like that. The behavior is endemic to humanity. I'm sure you can think of plenty of times that you (or perhaps it's easier to insert someone you love...) have been wrong and resisted accepting it.
One of the most obvious recent examples of this on the left-by very smart people-was the year-long emperor-has-no-clothes denial about [Joe Biden's cognitive decline](https://substack.com/redirect/07842173-23d6-4de7-bad4-024993adc4a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It was incredibly challenging as a candidate that something so obvious was being denied, and it's remarkable to see so many Democrats still struggling to accept that it was real and not just a media frenzy, despite the increasingly large volume of public evidence that eventually led to Biden stepping down and that continues to compile.
The knee-jerk response by Democrats, beyond that the decline was exaggerated, is usually that Trump is even crazier or losing it even more and is also old so it's hypocritical that people held it against Biden. But while that might make people feel better, it's just another form of denial, and it doesn't change the fact that this long-running denial about Biden's health and the aftermath is likely the single biggest reason that Trump is president right now.
I don't say this to needle anyone or to be contradictory, but to point out that this isn't unique to one political or educational or socio-economic demographic.
So, if denial and stubbornness are endemic, what do we do about it?
This brings us to the second notable political takeaway from Peter Hildebrand's interview about his daughter's death.
Right after meeting the Hildebrand's and his trip to Texas, RFK Jr. tweeted "The most effective way to prevent the spread of measles is the MMR vaccine," effectively contradicting decades of his own advocacy.
Afterward, when the press asked Peter about meeting RFK Jr., he simply replied:
"He didn't mention vaccines once. But he was the nicest man I ever met."
RFK Jr. had literally just betrayed this man, selling out to the political establishment, big pharma, and everything else by telling the world that MMR vaccines are effective.
And Peter Hildebrand still loved him.
Peter made up his mind about RFK Jr. a long time ago, and a little betrayal for the press and to keep his job was not going to change that relationship.
I have talked to and interacted with many many thousands of voters of all persuasions under very challenging circumstances, and RFK is an example of someone who has done what it takes to to break through with certain people and maintain that breakthrough.
Because, let's face it, on paper the people who like RFK shouldn't be into him. He's one of the biggest nepo babies of all time, scion of a great liberal family, who's never had to worry about anything, who spent his career as an environmental attorney going after big business, and who ran against Donald Trump.
So how did Peter come to be so pro-Kennedy and why didn't he go after Kennedy as just another slimeball flip-flopping politician when Kennedy flopped? Because Kennedy built trust and loyalty in many of the same ways that Trump did.
1. RFK earned trust and commitment by doing something that cost him. If you want people to believe and trust you, the best way to do that is by doing something that costs you. The higher the perceived cost, the better. Kennedy rejected his family legacy and elite society and became the subject of their disdain and scrutiny by becoming an anti-vaxxer. And he committed to it. Some of the things that our testing found persuaded people to trust me the most during my campaign were my positions that had a high cost or a perceived high cost, like rejecting all sorts of sources of campaign funding and being critical of the Democratic party and party leadership on things like stock ownership by members of congress.

2. RFK made Peter and others who otherwise felt neglected or ridiculed feel seen and respected. Some of the best headway we made in the campaign was going to communities that had been left behind.

3. RFK supported his people even when they were wrong and never confronted them. "He didn't mention vaccines once," Peter said about their meeting.

Combined, these are the foundational first steps to breaking through and changing behavior: earning trust, making people feel seen, and not antagonizing your counterpart.
The final step is building a permission structure- an emotional and psychological justification- for your counterpart to alter their behavior.
Going back to the beginning, I couldn't have successfully asked that Trump voter to vote for my Democratic State Rep candidate if I had argued with her about why Trump was bad for her.
Instead, I earned her trust based on a perceived cost or sacrifice (my deployments and military service), talked to her in a way that she felt seen and respected (and which alerted me to one of her core beliefs, corrupt politicians), and then, on that foundation, I built a permission structure around that core belief that allowed her to be both a Trump voter and a Democrat state rep voter.
Here is another example, this time of a permission structure we wanted to try in my campaign but didn't ultimately have enough money for.
A core belief of a vast amount of Missouri voters is that they are independent. This is deeply held to the point that they will say they are independent voters even if they hate Democrats, think that Democrats ruined America, and haven't voted for a single Democrat in a decade or more.
Our research found that people liked me a lot more than they liked my opponent (probably because I had built trust using steps 1-3 above and he hadn't), that a vast amount of voters considered themselves independent, but that they were worried about voting for a Democrat.
In this case, the permission structure would have been to run a mini-campaign along the lines of:
"You've always considered yourself independent, you say you aren't bound by either corrupt party, and in this election you have a chance to prove it, because you have a choice between the worst possible Republican and the best possible Democrat. So, are you independent, or aren't you?"
After building the foundation of trust, this was one way we would have liked to try to tap into a core belief to try to change a default course of action. I wish we could have tried it, but the Democratic brand is so bad in Missouri that we ran out of money on the building trust phase and weren't able to take the next step. (Reminder- with just the building trust phase we were [able to outperform the Dem ticket by 10 points in target areas](https://substack.com/redirect/f1e90275-058b-4649-9aa4-03199c974aae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite being outspent, so something here was working).
This approach isn't meant as a critique of facts, or to say that they aren't important, or that there isn't value in publicizing the shortcomings of what's going on right now.
The point of this is to acknowledge that there has been a deep shift in voting in this country. Missouri was a bellwether state for generations until 2016, for example. And to recognize that a reverse shift isn't likely to be based on facts or even experiences. That's just not how people work or make decisions.
A counter-shift won't be about bullying or confronting voters with all the ways they were wrong. It's going to require significant trust-earning sacrifices at the national level, like those I outlined in "[Time to Start Breaking Things"](https://substack.com/redirect/9e41f494-acae-4a09-8f77-3b557d7de472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), combined with making people feel seen and a permission structure that help them feel good about changing their minds. If those things happen, politics really will turn the corner faster than you could ever dream of.
If you've made it this far, you must be motivated to make some change, so thank you for being a part of that! Please share this with anyone you think would be interested in it or who would find it useful.
-Lucas

# Easter, Press Coverage, China’s Bluffing, AMERICAN PATRIOT.
**Easter**
I hope you had a peaceful and joyful Easter. I attended Weare Christian Church for Easter service in my hometown. Pastor Stockhaus asked what prayers the congregation and guests would like to request. I asked for the prayers for the people I love in my life, including my extended family relatives I have not seen for 10 years.

**Media Coverage**
Since my announcement of 2026 campaign for Congress in NH02, I have received positive media coverage. Here are a few:

[Lily Tang Williams Enters 2nd CD Race as Goodlander Considers Senate Run - NH Journal](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=a1bb4ed173&e=c338950e03)

(Note: Rep. Goodlander will re-run for her seat and _not run_ for Senate)

[Chinese-Born Republican Candidate Takes Another Swing At Winning Key House Seat | The Daily Caller](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=40d76baef5&e=c338950e03)

[WMURTV: Rematch possible in New Hampshire's 2nd District](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=92a147314b&e=c338950e03)

**Is China’s Bluffing over? **
Just what exactly is President Trump doing? Has China been bluffing with their latest trade announcements, and if so, is their bluffing over? I know the economy in China is pretty bad right now, 30% unemployment and terrible demographics, so enormous pressure by our administration can have real effect. China is posturing (read Sun Tsu) but the internal political infighting in China is real and very intense. China's President Xi may not last much longer. So, let the official US-China bilateral trade negotiations begin! A reasonable trade deal will be good for both countries and the world, of course, but President Trump must always put America first. After the Chinese leaders save face, President Trump wins with grace.

**AMERICAN PATRIOT**
My new meme AMERICAN PATRIOT T-shirts, posters & coffee mugs are available now in my personal store: [http://lilytangwilliams-shop.fourthwall.com](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=4c4d8fa88c&e=c338950e03) I have watched "The Patriot" many times since I came to the USA. In case you are wondering, though, why not show me riding a horse? I was born in the year of the dragon! The dragon represents power, strength, wisdom, and good fortune. It is considered an auspicious creature that brings luck and prosperity.

**Lily vs Maggie Rematch 2026**
I am answering my calling to run again for Congress in New Hampshire's second congressional district. I want to be at the forefront of a movement to help bring forth a new renaissance to the country I love and serve the people in #NH02 who welcomed me with open arms. [See my x.com video link here](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=850b7cb849&e=c338950e03)

Could you please donate? [Click here to donate](https://lilytangwilliams.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8317033781a524f5f640e7e3e&id=2c96cb03aa&e=c338950e03)

Thank you and God Bless

| | Earlier this month, I hit the road with Rep. Val Hoyle for packed town halls across Oregon's 4th Congressional District. Every event demonstrated why it's so important to have Val working for Oregon in Congress. Here's what we heard loud and clear: Folks are worried about the reliability of their Social Security benefits. Families are dealing with increased prices of everyday goods and groceries. Workers are wondering if the jobs they've counted on will be there tomorrow. **Here's what you need to know about Val: she always shows up.** For Val's entire career, she's stood shoulder to shoulder with working Americans, fighting for fair wages, affordable health care, and economic security to help families thrive. **She never wavers on her principles and never runs from a hard conversation.** All over the 4th District, we heard the same thing from folks. They want to make sure they can take care of their families, save for the future, and depend upon government programs and services like Social Security, Medicare, or even just the Post Office when they need them. clean_body: Here’s what we heard loud and clear: | | | | Earlier this month, I hit the road with Rep. Val Hoyle for packed town halls across Oregon's 4th Congressional District. Every event demonstrated why it's so important to have Val working for Oregon in Congress. Here's what we heard loud and clear: Folks are worried about the reliability of their Social Security benefits. Families are dealing with increased prices of everyday goods and groceries. Workers are wondering if the jobs they've counted on will be there tomorrow. Here's what you need to know about Val: she always shows up. For Val's entire career, she's stood shoulder to shoulder with working Americans, fighting for fair wages, affordable health care, and economic security to help families thrive. She never wavers on her principles and never runs from a hard conversation. All over the 4th District, we heard the same thing from folks. They want to make sure they can take care of their families, save for the future, and depend upon government programs and services like Social Security, Medicare, or even just the Post Office when they need them. They want a government that has their backs. Oregonians don't like the direction we're heading, and they didn't sign up for economic instability or Trump's authoritarian tactics. Val Hoyle will always fight for every Oregonian against Trump's chaos. = = Onward! Peter, One thing is abundantly clear: now, more than ever, saving our democracy is up to us. The most important office in this democracy is the citizen, the ordinary person who says, no, that’s not right. Too often, people underestimate the power of people. Those of us who care deeply about the future of our country need to fight for what we believe in. When one side tries to stack the deck and lock in a permanent grip on power — whether by actively suppressing votes, engaging in brazen gerrymandering, politicizing the armed forces, or using the criminal justice system to go after their opponents — we need to speak out, organize, and mobilize. **The question we face today is not simply whose policies and agendas will prevail, but whether the concept of democracy itself will endure. So this is not a time for acceptance and resignation — this is a time for commitment and action. ** I've been proud to support the NDRC since my friend Attorney General Eric Holder and I helped bring it to life in 2017. Its work to undo partisan gerrymandering has helped produce the fairest maps in a generation. And it’s one of the reasons why Democrats cut the Republican margin in the House from a 47-seat margin when President Trump first took office in 2017 to a historically low five seats after the 2024 election. | | In the face of the Republican Rip-Off, I am actively seeking out ways to stand up for Northwest Washington. **This month, I introduced the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025, legislation to permanently reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission in the Puget Sound and fund it at $10 million each fiscal year for the next six years, through Fiscal Year 2031.** The Commission is a community-led effort to restore marine habitats in the Northwest Straits region and address local threats. **This program provides funding, training, and support to seven county-based Marine Resources Committees (MRCs) and 15 Tribes to protect and enhance marine environments by:**
* Supporting water quality monitoring and improvement efforts
* Restoring shellfish populations
* Protecting vulnerable ecosystems
* Promoting growth for native water and shore-based plants, and
* Educating local residents about the health of the Northwest Straits marine waters

clean_body: This month, I introduced the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025. | | | | In the face of the Republican Rip-Off, I am actively seeking out ways to stand up for Northwest Washington. This month, I introduced the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative Reauthorization Act of 2025, legislation to permanently reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission in the Puget Sound and fund it at $10 million each fiscal year for the next six years, through Fiscal Year 2031. The Commission is a community-led effort to restore marine habitats in the Northwest Straits region and address local threats. This program provides funding, training, and support to seven county-based Marine Resources Committees (MRCs) and 15 Tribes to protect and enhance marine environments by: Supporting water quality monitoring and improvement efforts Restoring shellfish populations Protecting vulnerable ecosystems Promoting growth for native water and shore-based plants, and Educating local residents about the health of the Northwest Straits marine waters = = The Northwest Straits Initiative is a grassroots effort that draws its strength from community cooperation. By bringing together a diverse group of local leaders and community stakeholders, this initiative has long been a catalyst for well-executed projects that restore marine habitat, protect Washington state's environment, and create more jobs in Northwest Washington. A healthy environment is vital to Washingtonians' way of life and the regional economy, and that is why mitigating climate change through projects like the Northwest Straits Initiative must be a top priority. I look forward to working with members of the Washington delegation to pass this legislation to help the Commission continue its important work. body:

Dear Peter,
One of my favorite nights of the year is right around the corner. OLCV's Annual Celebration for the Environment is Friday, May 2nd, and you're invited! This is our last call for tickets, so get yours now [https://event.auctria.com/9b40f2d5-c6e6-405b-9d44-94934caf7291/] before it's too late!
Featuring inspiring speeches from notable elected officials , delicious food and Oregon wine and beer , an auction and paddle raise , and great company – all to benefit OLCV’s important work protecting our climate and environment.
OLCV’s Annual Celebration for the Environment
Friday, May 2nd, 2025
The Loft on 8th [https://maps.app.goo.gl/eaNsDooEsL9SKqeo8] , Portland, OR
Doors open at 5:30pm for a social/cocktail hour followed by dinner and program beginning at 7pm
This year we'll be joined by special guest Congresswoman Suzanne Bonamici ! You won't want to miss it!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/bonamici.jpeg]
Get your tickets [https://event.auctria.com/9b40f2d5-c6e6-405b-9d44-94934caf7291/]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ldXeaK1CK2I [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ldXeaK1CK2I]
New this year, we're giving away a once in a lifetime Grand Canyon glamping experience! Purchase a $100 raffle ticket for your chance to win (even if you can't attend the event)! [https://event.auctria.com/9b40f2d5-c6e6-405b-9d44-94934caf7291/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Stay in an eco sky dome 20 minutes from the south entrance to the Grand Canyon Park for 3 nights for 2 guests. Enjoy stargazing with telescopes, live music, and nightly s'mores on your trip as an added bonus to the breathtaking landscapes and proximity to the park! This is the prime, but rare, way to experience the Grand Canyon. Get your raffle tickets today! [https://event.auctria.com/9b40f2d5-c6e6-405b-9d44-94934caf7291/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
Enter to win! [https://event.auctria.com/9b40f2d5-c6e6-405b-9d44-94934caf7291/2ced078932954976aa791014bb7f88a3]
We hope you can join us for this very special night! For questions, email [april@olcv.org] OLCV Development Director April Christenson.
Thank you to our generous sponsors!

| | | For more than half a century, "60 Minutes" has taken on some of the most important and groundbreaking news stories, often making history. And it has taken on more than its share of villains in the process. **But it now appears that its journalistic independence is at risk, and that it may be avoiding stories critical of Trump, due to a ludicrous Trump lawsuit, and an impending sale of the parent company -- which must be approved by Trump's FCC. ([background](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8f59fd18-b832-43d9-8703-c972e92b0b0f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))** Bill Owens, the executive producer of 60 Minutes, is now leaving the show in protest: "Over the past months, it has also become clear that I would not be allowed to run the show as I have always run it. To make independent decisions based on what was right for '60 Minutes,' right for the audience." ([NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T095bc4e2-6bef-487f-bbe7-5c836c4390d4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) At a time when we are fighting to save our democracy, we need 60 Minutes to defend the First Amendment, not throw it away out of fear or greed. # [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21486?t=1&akid=39667%2E3422442%2EYRr8yE)
Dear Derek,
I just read that the Trump-Vance administration is evaluating policies to get women to have more children.
I’m a mom of three, I love kids. Let’s see what they have to say.
**Their big idea? Teaching women about our menstrual cycles.**
No, really.
Grown women don’t need lectures from Donald Trump or JD Vance about our bodies. What we need are policymakers actually doing something to make it easier and more affordable to raise a family.
It’s true that many Americans are delaying having kids or choosing not to have them. That’s their choice, and they should be free to make that choice. But we also know that plenty of people want to grow their families, but they’re choosing not to because child care, housing, healthcare, and college are all way too expensive.
If Trump and Vance are serious about helping Americans start their families, they should be proposing policies to bring down the cost of things like child care. Those are the biggest chunks of a family’s budget, and Americans know it.

And he and his advisors think lessons about periods are the answer?
Get real.

clean_body: Dear Derek, I just read that the Trump-Vance administration is evaluating policies to get women to have more children. I’m a mom of three, I love kids. Let’s see what they have to say. Their big idea? Teaching women about our menstrual cycles. No, really. Grown women don’t need lectures from Donald Trump or JD Vance about our bodies. What we need are policymakers actually doing something to make it easier and more affordable to raise a family. It’s true that many Americans are delaying having kids or choosing not to have them. That’s their choice, and they should be free to make that choice. But we also know that plenty of people want to grow their families, but they’re choosing not to because child care, housing, healthcare, and college are all way too expensive. If Trump and Vance are serious about helping Americans start their families, they should be proposing policies to bring down the cost of things like child care. Those are the biggest chunks of a family’s budget, and Americans know it. Trump’s signature tariff policy is making everything more expensive for us—from groceries to baby products. And he and his advisors think lessons about periods are the answer? Get real. —Katie PS: If you didn’t already see, I filmed a video about this topic. Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.
